row.name: Switch Poker
row.detailed_description: Switch Poker is an online poker hand builder all about trading cards with your opponents! Keep strong cards for yourself and give away the rest to create the best hand possible. You'll need every edge you can get to win when playing against up to 8 other players. Think about what cards your opponent will trade with you to stay one step ahead! The definitive online poker trading experience. Let the jazzy soundtrack get you in a rhythm to enjoy a thrilling poker trading session!
row.short_description: The poker trader. Switch Poker is a fast-paced, rewarding handbuilder where you trade cards with other players, strategize against opponent playstyles, and create the best poker hand.

row.name: OUTL1NED
row.detailed_description: OUTL1NED is a manic One-Dimensional arcade shooter where you last as long as you can while enjoying a colourful lightshow in the background. Even though enemies can only come from 2 intense directions rather than 360 flaccid degrees , you will have to focus to keep the pressure at bay and manage which direction needs your attention. You will be challenged to manage your constantly-regenerating ammo and collect a variety of diverse upgrades as you go in order to last as long as you can. Battle a variety of colour-coordinated enemy types that will vary in speed, health, and visibility that will force you to make tough decisions as they close in. row.name: Kosmolaris
row.detailed_description: Kosmolaris is a relaxing puzzle game where you'll have combine a wide variety of elements to create new ones, starting with four basic elements:  Air 💨, Fire 🔥, Earth 🍃 and  Water 💧. Some elements are based on chemical principles, while others rely more on common sense or reverse engineering. There are two types of elements:   Common and  Special . Don’t worry if you don’t find them—they aren't the main goal of the game. But if you're curious... Some features: 6 languages for now: Spanish (Latam), Spanish (Spain), English, Italian, Portuguese and French. Outstanding elements art! +200 common elements. +15 special elements (fiction, easter eggs). +30 achievements. Auto-save for each movement. Relaxing background music.

row.name: Draconis 8
row.detailed_description: Unique Decks • Tactical Duels • Compact Strategy What is Draconis 8? With iron, heart, scales, deadly breath weapons, and unmatched intelligence, dragons reign supreme. But when disputes arise between these mighty rulers, they are not settled by armies… but by the  Draconis 8 . Each dragon gathers a warband — themselves and  seven legendary champions  — to battle another dragon’s team. These duels decide the fate of empires, played through a fast-paced, deeply strategic card game. 8-Card Decks Every duel begins with a lean but powerful force:  one mighty Dragon ,  seven Champions , and a  neutral Terrain card  that sets the stage. This compact design means there's no wasted space — every card has weight, and every decision matters. Your Dragon is your ace, boasting multiple abilities and devastating stats, but the Champions you surround it with will determine how battles unfold. Your deck might pair a fearsome Red Dragon with orc warriors, elven archers, and a sly goblin trickster — each one contributing a unique way to score or disrupt. Simultaneous Play Unlike most card games where players alternate turns, some parts of Draconis 8  is played in real-time mind games . Both players draw, then secretly choose a card to play. When revealed, the card with higher initiative earns a point and resolves first. This keeps the pace brisk and tense: you're always thinking ahead, bluffing, and trying to predict your rival's next move. Will your opponent commit their Dragon early for raw power, or hold it back for a decisive late strike? Do you counter with a solid Champion… or risk everything on a bold play? Tactical Positioning Cards don't just hit the table —  where you place them is just as important as what you play . Each card you add connects to the growing battlefield, scoring when adjacent to foes. Initiative determines first placement, but positioning unlocks deep tactical layers: block off scoring lines, rotate enemies, or create chains of allies that amplify one another's abilities. Your Champion of Fear rotates an enemy Paladin just enough that their strong side no longer scores points — swinging the round in your favor. Unique Abilities Every card carries a special ability that warps the rules in your favor or sabotages your foe. Dragons often wield multiple powers, but even humble Champions can deliver game-changing effects. Some bend the battlefield (rotating, swapping, shielding), others manipulate scoring (stealing, multiplying, or redirecting points). Combined, they create endless tactical puzzles — and no two decks play the same. A stealthy Rogue Champion lets you sneak victory beads from one card to another, while your Dragon unleashes a devastating ability that clears a row of enemies. Victory in 7 Rounds The battle is short, sharp, and conclusive: after  seven rounds of simultaneous duels , the player with the most victory points claims the match. No endless grind, no drawn-out stalemates — just pure, focused strategy packed into 15–30 minutes. You're tied in points after round six. In the final round, your Dragon enters the field and tips the balance, claiming the decisive victory. Glory is yours. Why Draconis 8 Over Other Games? Board Game & TCG in One Play right out of the box, or customize decks like a trading card game. Physical & Digital Integration Scan your terrain card to unlock your exact deck in the  Draconis 8 app . Instant Digital Play Battle the AI, join global matchmaking, and compete in tournaments. Endless Replayability Every card is algorithmically generated with  millions of possible combinations . They are also mathematically balanced, with no rare cards to chase. Every Pack is Tournament Legal No wasted pulls — all cards are balanced.
row.short_description: Draconis 8: A fast-paced, highly accessible tactical card game. Each booster pack is also a fully playable, unique deck with 1 Dragon, 7 Champions, and 1 Terrain. Unlike other TCG-style games, each card is not only unique, but balanced. Play single-pack, constructed, or triple-pack - online or solo.

Life is Feudal: Arden
row.detailed_description: New lands Explore a hand-crafted map offering distinct PvP and PvE zones, ensuring that there’s something for everyone. In special PvPvE areas, you can hunt dangerous Knools for valuable resources. Stay alert at all times, as you may become the hunted if other players are after the same treasures. Enhanced crafting and construction Gather resources to forge high-quality weapons and gear. With streamlined and clearer recipes, you can spend more time focusing on other essential aspects of the game. Build everything from modest shelters to prosperous villages and impregnable castles. The scale is limited only by your imagination. Dynamic character progression Gone are the days of needing multiple characters for different professions. In Arden, you can switch skills on your main character whenever you like. Visit a monument and become a blacksmith, farmer, or swap your tools for a sword to jump into battle. The choice is always yours! Realistic trading system    Trading in Arden is as close to reality as it gets. With limited spots for trading posts, you’ll need to choose your locations wisely. There’s no instant delivery; you must personally transport goods for sale. And beware—bandits lie in wait, ready to raid your caravan. Whether defending your goods or threatening others, stay vigilant on the trade routes. Unique combat & epic battles   Combat in Life is Feudal: Arden is both intuitive and realistic—striking your enemy requires precision, and physical stats matter. Fight alongside allies in massive battles, participate in sieges, or hone your skills in the arena with PvP duels or group PvP skirmishes. The battlefield is your playground. Power struggles & political intrigue    Step into a real political sandbox where alliances are made and broken. Participate in large-scale sieges and territory wars, conquer land on a real-world map, and tax those you defeat. In this world, might makes right—winners write the history books. Create your own medieval realm Step into a realistic medieval world with limitless possibilities, where your decisions shape not only your in-game experience but the game’s development itself. Life is Feudal: Arden was made in close cooperation with players, with feedback driving important choices. Your voice plays a direct role in the future of the game.
row.short_description: Life is Feudal: Arden is a new free-to-play open-world MMORPG set in the Middle Ages, built on the foundation of Life is Feudal: MMO. Engage in thrilling PvP combat, navigate political intrigue, master a variety of professions and craft unique items. Forge your own path to power and greatness!

row.name: Exsanguination

Will you survive the night or become a victim of the very creatures you once hunted? row.short_description: Exsanguination is a fast-paced, first-person melee combat game where you play as a former vampire hunter turned into a vampire. With your new vampiric powers, fight against your enemies to reclaim your humanity in a dark, brutal world.

row.name: Lumen: World of Color
row.detailed_description: In Lumen you take on the role of a druid seeking to cleanse an ancient fortress and stop it from spreading its corruption to the forest.  Lumen is a third-person action-adventure with stylized pixelated graphics. You progress through the game by solving puzzles and clearing corruption.  Companion  You'll be accompanied by a spirit along your journey, giving you helpful tips and commenting on the environment, in a supposedly non-annoying way.    Cure the land  A corruption is draining the land of its life force and leaving only its roots and minions to inhabit the landscape.  Find sources of corruption and destroy them to remove the corruption and bring back life that was drained from the land.    Puzzles  Solve multiple types of puzzles to access new areas.  The game has three types of puzzles that you’ll find along your way and need to solve to finish the game.  Crafting  Around the world there are useful materials to make weapons and potions, to help your journey.  At the moment the game has two melee weapons and two ranged weapons. And the ranged weapon needs arrows to shoot.  Fighting  Third person real-time combat with melee and ranged attacks.  Boss fight  At the end you’ll face off with the source of the corruption. Evil mage that has encased their soul into a skeletal statue.  Lore  On your adventure you’ll find the story of the world in books and dialog telling the rich history of the land.   Music  Lumen has a lot of ambiance, and adaptive music.  Thank you for reading. This is a school project that was made in about 3 months, and the group will disband after publishing.
row.short_description: Lumen: World of Color is an action adventure game made as a student project.

row.name: Fate of the Three Kingdoms
row.detailed_description: Fate of the Three Kingdoms is a turn base card game about the era of the Three Kingdoms. Collect different heroes from the time ranging like Liu Bei, Cao Cao and Sun Jian. Deploy tactics that act as spells in traditional card games. Equip legendary weapons and horses or lay traps like Ambush or Empty City. Play solo against the AI or online against other players. Complete the various solo campaign scenarios to earn rewards in game. The objective of the game is to defeat the other player (AI or real) by bringing their total to 0 or less. This can be done by using your deployed units (hero cards) to attack them or by depleting their card stack to 0, each turn after cumulative damage is applied. You can earn coins to buy packs by playing online games against other players or completing the ten campaigns. Early access will have the Shu, Wei and Wu factions with a total of 65 cards including some neutral characters and tactics. Plans would be to later on add factions led by Dong Zhuo, Yuan Shao and Ma Teng to name a few.
row.short_description: A collectible turn base strategy card game. Collect all the cards, rank up in multiplayer and/or complete the scenarios in solo play.

row.notes: This game contains realistic and unrealistic depictions of death, and violence, as well, as ironic use of Nazi imagery.

row.name: Dark Assassin: Trial Chambers
row.detailed_description: THIS GAME IS IN ALPHA 1.0.0. & WILL RECEIVE SMALL TWEAKS AND UPDATES Play as Dark Assassin and maneuver your way through the 8 chambers to fight the Goblin Lord and discover your true intentions. In this quick action paced game, you will find yourself slicing through goblins, bandits, and eyes while zipping across each chamber. Immerse yourself into the thumping music, iconic pixel characters and carefully crafted story as fast as possible to reach a higher score.  Can you achieve the impossible? Find out and play Dark Assassin!
row.short_description: A quick and exciting action paced game, can you defeat the goblin lord?

row.name: 春秋无义战
row.detailed_description: It's completely made by a personal whim.But it's not completely copied.It's absorbed part of the gameplay.Try to build a new system.I hope to bring a fresh and familiar experience. 1. The nature of the game: This game is a turn-based card, which needs to be played online, due to the limited cost, it is actually a LAN connection, and the machine where the owner is located is used as the host. 2. Playing Objectives: Each player plays the role of a vassal state in a celebrity period in the Spring and Autumn Period, divided into two camps: [Righteousness] and [Injustice], the goal of the [Righteousness] camp is to destroy all the [Unjust] forces, and the goal of the [Unjust] forces is to destroy all other forces. 3. Basic resources: Each player initially has an initial tripod card, with a certain number of cards, and at the same time has the initial strategy of power cards, and draws five cards at the beginning of the game. The number of cards drawn determines the number of cards, the number of feet represents the amount of health, and the upper limit of the hand is equal to the number of cards + the number of feet. The number of tripods and feet is not fixed, and the tripod is obtained by inflicting damage on other forces, and the damage is reflected in the foot. 4. Player turn: Each player plays a round in turn according to the number of seats, and a round is divided into a turning stage, a drawing stage, a card playing stage, and a fold stage. Only the [righteous] forces have a turning stage, and they can choose to turn into [unjust] forces; Draw the cards according to the number of the number of cards; In the card playing stage, you can use game cards, take the initiative to launch a strategy, and declare war on other forces to enter the war period; Fold phase according to the number of pins + full number = hand cap. 5. Game cards: Game cards are divided into dry cards, conspiracy cards, conspiracy cards, strategy cards, and special cards. Gange cards are used in times of war, as; Yangmou cards are played in the playing phase to play an effect; The conspiracy card is limited to one time in the card playing phase, played and given to the opponent to determine whether it causes damage; After the strategic cards are played, they are covered in the strategic area and play an effect; Special card effects play single, pair, and all of them to play different effects. Personal attempts, and not good at painting, so the picture is relatively simple, and there may be some unknown bugs, please forgive me. If you find a bug, or if you have a suitable card pattern or music material, you can point the way in the comment area, thank you very much.
row.short_description: A multiplayer card battle game based on allusions from the Spring and Autumn Period of China, similar to the Three Kingdoms x style. This game is completely based on ancient Chinese idioms, which is inconvenient to translate, so you will not be able to play if you cannot understand Chinese.

row.name: Tales Beyond The Tomb - Pineville Night Stalker
row.detailed_description: “Tales Beyond The Tomb” is a chilling episodic horror series that immerses players in the shadows of real-life cases. Inspired by the gritty, atmospheric horror of the 80s and 90s, each episode simulates the frightening experiences of real people, mixing nostalgia with unrelenting suspense. This is the first episode of the series: Episode 1: Pineville Night Stalker After her mother's unexpected death, Megan receives a call about a sudden and mysterious inheritance awaiting in the desolate town of Pineville. With her work friend, Lenny – she embarks on a journey that should be simple, but quickly turns into a web of danger and deceit. Key Features VHS Aesthetic — Step back in time with visuals inspired by classic horror films of the ’80s and ’90s. Photorealistic Graphics & Immersive Environments — Feel the dread with lifelike visuals and haunting settings. Voice Activity — Interaction system with your microphone (no microphone is needed to play, but this increases your interaction and involves a complete experience). Dialog Text System — Immerse yourself in the plot with dynamic, narrative-driven dialogues. Gameplay A first-person exploration experience (walking simulator), where realism is fundamental. Navigate immersive locations, discover disturbing truths, and face your fears.
row.short_description: After her mother's unexpected death, Megan receives a call about a mysterious inheritance awaiting her in the town of Pineville. With her work friend, Lenny, she embarks on a journey that should be simple, but quickly turns into a web of danger and deception.

row.name: NumX
row.detailed_description: NumX is back! After 2 years, NumX is back with an improved version. Rediscover old mini-games and discover new ones, alone or with friends, in the same room or on the other side of the world. New game modes are also planned to bring a new experience around the mini-games. Original NumX content such as old skins and music will also make a comeback. NumX is a party-game containing several mini-games that can be played alone or with others, in which you play as a simple cube. And yes, sometimes simplicity is best. You can play online with a friend, or locally on the same computer. NumX has a variety of minigames that you can play such as : Survival VS In VS Survival your goal is to avoid the grey cube for as long as possible! Air Hockey In Air Hockey, you have to be the first team to score 5 goals to win the game ! Obstacles In Obstacles, you have to avoid the obstacles that appear so that they don't push you into the water! And more...! In NumX, you can play with up to 4 friends locally or online and compete for victory! Each player can play on the same keyboard or connect their controller! If you decide to play NumX minigames alone you will be awarded coins at the end of each game! With coins you can buy skins to customize your cube, backgrounds for the play frame, titles to display on your profile or emojis to use while playing online! During events that are sometimes held, you even win double the amount of coins, so make use of them! We hope you will have fun on NumX!
row.short_description: NumX is a party-game with several mini-games, in which you play as a simple cube.

row.name: Molehill Empire 2
row.detailed_description: You’re an enthusiastic hobby gardener, you can tell apples from oranges, you like your harden, and you love growing vegetables and more? Then team up with the cute and quirky gnomes of Molehill Empire 2 on your way from a self-sufficient gardener to an international supplier of sustainable and organic products. MOLEHILL EMPIRE 2 – MORE THAN JUST A FLOWERBED! Gardening with a green thumb: alone or in a team – there’s always plenty to do! Co-op and communication: a built-in messenger helps you trade with friends Research and field work: Discover new plants and upgrade your garden Heirlooms and achievements: Collect accolades and trophies to impress your friend ORGANIC GARDENING GAME In Molehill Empire 2, you’ll experience a skillful blend of garden game, hilarious and quirky moments, and a complex tycoon right in the comfort of your garden plot. Sow, harvest, and sell crops; research new cultivation methods, and unlock new plants. Conquer the top of the world – alone or with friends! TRADE AND GROW: YOUR EMPIRE IS FLOURISHING The way to the top is not always easy. That’s why teamwork is of utmost importance in the Molehill Empire app. Even the most clever gnome could sometimes use a helping hand! Invite friends to trade, chat, and have fun with you. In this engaging community game, helping each other is the best part! The Molehill Empire 2 app cannot be linked with your Molehill Empire browser game account. Molehill Empire was funded in part by the FilmFernsehFonds (FFF) Bayern.
row.short_description: Lively gnomes, gardening and research - your garden plot is the place to be!

row.name: RoboSoul
row.detailed_description: ROBOSOUL is a thrilling 2D top-down shooter that puts you in the metallic shoes of ROBO-07, engaging in a desperate struggle for survival amidst a treacherous, robot-filled stronghold. With its endless gameplay loop and subtle roguelike twists, each run promises a fresh challenge, keeping the action intense and the surprises coming. One of the standout features is the game's innovative dual-wielding system, enabling you to mix and match weapons for both your left and right hands, and tailor your combat approach to your preferences. The game's retro pixel art style adds a nostalgic charm, while the execution of special finisher moves—executed with flair—adds a satisfying layer of skill and style to the gameplay, ensuring that no two battles are the same.
row.short_description: The game features a dynamic left-and-right hand weapon system, allowing players to freely mix and match weapons for maximum carnage as they face relentless waves of enemies. With its retro pixel art style and intense action, ROBOSOUL delivers a nostalgic yet exhilarating arcade experience.

row.name: Mortimer: First Launch
row.detailed_description: Mortimer: First Launch is a 3D puzzle stealth adventure starring Mortimer, a raccoon with big dreams and a scientific mind. Set in a whimsical, fantasy version of Florida's Hatbill Park near the Kennedy Space Center, Mortimer navigates his environment, solves puzzles, and collects the parts he needs to build a rocket and achieve his dream of reaching the moon, all while avoiding humans and predatory wildlife along the way. The First Launch version of the game includes the tutorial, taking place at Mortimer's home and the nearby Hatbill Park camping area. Mortimer: First Launch is a work in progress by a team of students from Jyväskylä University of Applied Science in Jyväskylä, Finland. What You’ll Do: - Run, walk, crawl, climb and swim through the swamps, rivers and campgrounds in the Hatbill Park area. - Solve environmental puzzles integrated into the game world. - Sneak past humans, wildlife and other obstacles using stealth and cunning. Features: - Puzzle-Stealth Gameplay : Use a combination of logic, physics and deductive reasoning to overcome challenges and obtain rocket parts. - Stylized Art : A medium-poly world brought to life with toon shading and vibrant colors. - Interactable Environments : Each area contains interactable elements, environmental storytelling, and a few hidden secrets. - Narrative Cutscenes : Story beats are conveyed through a mixture of animated cutscenes and custom 2D art. - Immersive Audio : Ambisonic audio crafted using custom made generators help the world feel alive and believable. - Accessibility : Mortimer: First Launch features no spoken lines, instead relying on facial expressions, 2D art and animated thought bubbles to convey information. - Visual Effects : Comic book inspired visual effects accompany certain key actions during gameplay. Join Mortimer on a journey that’s as much about solving puzzles as it is about dreaming big! Team Core team: David Vanderheyden - Scrum Master, Programmer, Design Lead, Publishing and Marketing Co-Leader Jeremy LeBlanc - VFX Artist, Environmental design Pyry Kääriä - Audio, Manuscript Sami Huttula - 3D Art, Publisher Tero Korpela - Game programming Special thanks: Dion Dimache - 2D Art Flavio Florovits - Game testing Juulia Kääriä - 2D Art Unia Kääriä - Typeface designer
row.short_description: A whimsical stealth-puzzle adventure starring Mortimer, a curious raccoon 🦝

row.name: Mushroom Investigates：The Fleeing Rain
row.detailed_description: When the rain no longer travels with the wind, but rushes indoors, it turns into “the escaping rain” . Why does this strange weather happen? Mushroom, an investigator of curious cases, receives a vague request to investigate a house, but the owner of the house, the carpenter Cielo, seems to have the slightest inkling of it. A weird atmosphere pervades the place, with strange wooden ears everywhere, “They seem to have popped up recently, probably because it's been raining for too long.” You'll play as Mushroom, tracking down clues and solving mysteries. Mushroom Investigates into Curious Cases: the Escaping Rain is a point-and-click adventure puzzle game developed by slowicrowi. Game length: 0.5-2 hours How to play: Left mouse button: Move/Interact/Confirm Right mouse button: Call out menu/Cancel Game Features: Imaginative art style -Fall down the rabbit hole and embark on a fantasy adventure! Immersive clue-collecting experience -You can interact with all objects (but be careful to identify!) Even the most common items seem to have their own personality Unique puzzles that follow the plot 3 different ends 3 original music tracks
row.short_description: A vague invitation, a dizzy carpenter, and wooden ears everywhere...... What happened here, and  is there a connection to the strange weather? The one who is about to help to find the truth is a common mushroom coming for money.

row.name: Scrapped
row.detailed_description: Get ready to work at your corporate job as an Art Generator. Incoming work orders range from heartwarming birthday cards to ominous threats. The convenient projector-printer makes it easy to find all the images you're looking for and print out as many copies as you need. Time flies when you’re making collages! After work, talk to your coworkers at the virtual water cooler during your designated break time! Your manager seems quite nice but… What’s with all the rules against personal details? Working here, you feel like a number. Just a number… Create Collages! Use the projector-printer and a variety of reels to print out pictures to use in your collage. Move, rotate, scale, and flip the artwork to put together your perfect composition! Then it's ready for your eager customer to use! Answer Commisions. Every collage made in “Scrapped” is made using artwork in the public domain. That means YOU can use any collage you create however you’d like!  Uncover company mysteries... After every work day, head to the virtual water cooler to discover a gripping story about three souls unable to put their personality aside in a corporate dystopian world that discourages individuality. Despite the looming threat of unemployment, these humans can’t help but be, well, human.  A Collage of Commentary Scrapped blends thoughtful commentary about the ethical concerns regarding AI and capitalism. Corporations threaten to deindividualize people meanwhile AI threatens the same towards art. The looming threat of commodification is peppered throughout the narrative advanced and complemented by the mechanic of collage making.
row.short_description: Gestalt Industries, Ltd. is looking for a qualified candidate for the Art Generator role. Complete your work orders by creating collages using an array of snippets: from photographs to posters to Victorian etchings. Hang out by the virtual water cooler for fun, company sanctioned small talk!

row.name: Bilge Junction
row.detailed_description: My body burned in the cold, until I felt nothing. When I opened my eyes, I was back where I started… Welcome to Bilge Junction , population 8: a dying town on the arctic highway. With the promise of a cheap roof over your head, you ran from your problems and wound up here. But winter's setting in, and the fire keeps burning. A storm is on its way. There's something lurking in the pipeline that built the town. In three days' time, it's bound to escape. Enter a world with a life of its own.   The townsfolk of Bilge Junction follow their own routines from day to day. The town works on its own rules. As the storm draws closer, Bilge Junction grows more erratic with each passing hour. Survive. Explore. Earn the townsfolks' respect. Weather the harsh climate and earn your keep, learning what makes each person here tick. Hear out their stories, gain their trust, and survive together. Discover what lies beneath the surface of Bilge Junction. And whatever you do, don't let the fire go out. Bilge Junction was initially developed over a span of 5 weeks for IndieCade's Climate Jam 2024. The premise was meant to express several experiences I personally had when returning to my hometown, as well as confront the destructive, extractive, colonial past and present of Alaska. Inspirations include ThreeStep , Pathologic , Chulip , and Paper Mario. Credits Gage Tilly - Director Will B. Francis - Narrative Designer, Engineer Jorge Zamora Salguero - Composer, Sound Designer Luke Cravey - Artist David Norton - Narrative Designer
row.short_description: Welcome to Bilge Junction, population 8: a dying town on the arctic highway. With the promise of a cheap roof over your head, you ran from your problems and wound up here. But winter's setting in, and the fire keeps burning. A storm is on its way.

row.name: Absolution
row.detailed_description: Absolution is a first-person visual novel. In the eerie depths of this psychological thriller, face THE JUDGE and a twisted tale of grief, guilt and murder.  Confront your sins. Reflect on your morals. Liars will be punished. Immersive Horror Experience : Come immerse yourself in an experience that blends eerie visuals with haunting soundscapes as an unnerving story unveils before you. Unnerving Questions : Answer THE JUDGE’s probing questions, where honesty is key—liars will be punished. Chilling Narrative : Witness the unraveling of a tale filled with desperation, guilt, and the lingering hope for redemption. Compelling Characters : Meet the characters of this horrific story. Can they be saved from their fatal fates? Absolution was developed within the University of Southern California's Games Program. For more information about the USC Games Program, check out their website.
row.short_description: Absolution is a first-person psychological horror experience where you face THE JUDGE as they peel apart your very soul. Uncover dark truths and navigate moral dilemmas as you're questioned about your past deeds. Every lie has consequences.

row.name: Lanesplitterz

Face off against the city's top Lanesplitterz in a battle against corruption to win the tournament and become the King! BOWL: Be the ball as you bowl against 3 unique anime-style bosses. CHALLENGE: Experience each boss' dramatic story, each with custom over-the top character art, special abilities, and custom music. DOMINATE: Save Neo Las Vegas from the tyrannical rule of King Julius Caesar!
row.short_description: Lanesplitterz is a 3D arcade-style bowling game. Join Hiro as he competes in a brutal bowling tournament to become King of Neo Las Vegas!

row.name: Pig & Chikin
row.detailed_description: About This Game Pig & Chikin is a 3D platformer where the core movement abilities get weaker as a metaphor for physical disability and aging. In a world where pigs have wings and can fly, Pig loses her wings in an accident and desperately wants them back. Her friend, Chikin, joins her on an adventure to learn how to fly again. Their journey brings them to magical places where they meet creatures who offer insights into themes of companionship, community, and acceptance of immovable change. Personal experience inspired the story of an accident, an aging caregiver, and the emergence of a caregiving community, with several characters inspired by relatives. After its feature at USC Games Expo 2024, the game was completed and released as a passion project. row.name: Kai UnEarthed
row.detailed_description: Kai Unearthed is a meditation on an unpoliced future healing from climate change. In this interactive 3D world, you can become a Wildtender, someone who heals the relationship between humans and more-than-human beings. Reflect on the choices you make, the artifacts you leave behind, and the worlds that will grow out of them, through a journal, an interactive story, and a psychedelic scavenger hunt. Jump into a psychedelic Afrofuturist world as you take on the role of Kai, an aspiring Wildtender! Nurture relationships through an interactive dialogue system. row.short_description: Explore an afrofuturistic 3D world scavenging and journaling your way to becoming a wildtender: someone who heals the relationship between humans and more-than-human beings. row.name: Hyperborea
row.detailed_description: Hyperborea is a modern take on the classic First-person shooter game Wolfenstein 3D - the game that kick started the FPS revolution has been re-imagined in modern high definition graphics that is sure to push modern graphics cards to their limits. Fresh and exciting visuals for a hyper-eccentric modern era. This game is not for the low spec'd. 😉 A game, a modern benchmark, a fun and relaxing shooter, will it run Hyperborea? You play the entire game armed with a very capable shotgun; but missing a shot will double the cool down time for the next shot. Staying in flow is vital. Always watch your back because it's side swipes from enemies when turning corners that can catch you out. There is no health in this game, if a monster gets near to you - that's it you die. You will however obtain a crucifix/caduceus for every 4 kills which will give you a short protection if caught by a monster, this protection lasts 3 seconds and protects you from the initial monster that caught you and any further monsters in the next 3 second time period. Monsters make no noise until you kill them, your only way of detecting them is visually when you see them or when the way-point hand begins to shake, it will shake more aggressively the closer you are and it will only shake when an enemy is somewhere in the direction you are currently facing. Fight your way through the hordes of enemies and complete the game, there's no story-line, just a mindless shooter with a progression through new and interesting high definition 3D content and world geometry, think of it as a relaxing adventure through a modern take on the classic Wolfenstein 3D game, the game-play is a satisfyingly repetitive shooter set in memorably themed environments where the visuals are ever changing as you progress from environment to environment on your quest to the ultimate final goal - whatever that may be. Wow crazy sounds bro! Did you steal those from Doom? Thanks, you are right those sounds are pretty wild! Believe it or not I did not steal those sound effects from Doom - actually the circumstances are far more interesting; Those sound effects have been created entirely from scratch by Per Kristian Risvik, the original Doom sounds having only been sampled at a measly 11 kHz Kristian took it upon himself to remake them from scratch in 32 kHz and did a marvellous job in doing so, sounding identical to the original sound effects in many cases but in a higher quality! Having based my game around providing an up-to-date Doom-esque/Wolfenstein 3D experience it just made complete sense to also include Kristians sounds! Check out Kristians website for more information about how he remade these remarkable sound effects from scratch, audio reverse engineering at it's finest! Dude this game looks nuts  ᕕ( ᐛ )ᕗ You're right the game does look different, and it is technically quite a unique game indeed. At any point in the game your GPU could be rendering around 30 million triangles! If you are lucky the minimum it might be rendering in a single frame is 8 million triangles! In just 6 GB of disk space we are able to cram a whopping 184 million triangles of unique 3D content!! (184,597,952 triangles using 92,546,029 vertices to be exact). Not even a AAA game attempts to render the amount of triangles per frame that Hyperborea does - and get this, we even force the game to start in 16x MSAA if your graphics card supports it, otherwise we use the highest MSAA the GPU will let us use!  (really, when was the last time you saw a AAA game even let you select MSAA, let alone upto 16x MSAA! this is real anti-aliasing not some temporal TSAA or DLSS AI slop).  We render so many triangles that the bottleneck on most GPU's is the triangle rendering stage of the rasterization process! That means the MSAA or screen resolution in most cases makes little to no difference to the FPS - even at 1440p with 16x MSAA (that's 59 million pixels!!!) an original Intel Iris Xe iGPU from 2020 will get 30 FPS in this game. If you compare the performance of Iris Xe iGPU's since it's first release in 2020 and a modern intel CPU in 2025 the performance difference is only +13% making the Iris XE a good test case. That's why we call Hyperborea a benchmark, it is a benchmark of triangle rasterization!

row.name: Man in a suit in a building in a city
row.detailed_description: Deep in the never-changing autumn, surrounded by the tall buildings of the city. Men in suits move like shadows between the asphalt bridges. Can the songs of their childhood and the sweet taste of a drink make them forget the lies they find in a melancholic sunset? A short almost-linear novel game written for the common man. -Reading time of 5-10 mins. -Almost no sounds, or music. Disturbing noise loops. -Graphics picturing the loud emptiness of a city full of people.
row.short_description: A tale as old as machines. Everyday wake up and plow the land of your lord, as you need the shine of the coin. Requiem for the common man.
row.notes: Contains text descriptions of violent actions of various kinds. It does not contain loud sounds or disturbing images.

row.detailed_description: Explore this hand built world where nothing is as it seems!                                  Uncover the BIG secrets of Little Laboratories Inc!      Included Features:           ►    Mild Horror Elements         ►    Spooky Chases         ►    Jump Scares         ►    Charming Characters         ►    Hidden Secrets         ►    Easy To Understand Puzzles         ►    Collectable Lore         ►    Grab and Toss Physics Objects          ►    Interesting and Unique Story         ►    Respects Player's Time (Approx. 40 min length)
row.short_description: Explore and survive the spooky puzzling world of Little Screamies! BUT BEWARE!! Not everything is as it seems at Little Laboratories Inc...

row.name: The Dispatcher
row.detailed_description: Overview: Dive into the world of The Dispatcher , a 2D visual novel, adventure game where you take on the role of Dominic, a dispatcher navigating the complexities of urban life. As you carry out your duties, you start to uncover dark and mysterious aspects of the city that may be linked to a sinister cult. Heavenbrook is no longer the quiet town you once knew. Unexplained phenomena and terrifying situations begin to unfold, shocking and disturbing the city's residents. Key Features: Intriguing Storyline: Explore the dark atmosphere of Heavenbrook and uncover the secrets it holds. Engaging Gameplay: Make decisions as a dispatcher and witness their consequences on the story and characters. Stunning Aesthetic: Enjoy beautifully pixel art graphics that bring the city's atmosphere to life. Are you ready to explore the mysteries of Heavenbrook? Join us to uncover the truth hidden in the night!
row.short_description: Step into the role of Dominic, a dispatcher in Heavenbrook, where your choices shape a gripping visual novel and adventure game filled with suspense, mystery, and dark secrets. Unravel the chilling mysteries as the shocking events in the city unfold before you.
row.notes: The game contains mature themes and content that may not be suitable for all audiences. This includes graphic depictions of violence, blood, and gore, as well as strong language, realistic injury portrayals, and scenes involving psychological tension and horror elements. The game also features themes of drug and alcohol use, which are integrated into the narrative. Certain characters may be depicted consuming substances, with the consequences of addiction explored within the story. There are descriptions of sexual assault, references to non-consensual sex, and depictions of self-harm. The game also includes BDSM scenarios and addresses various social issues throughout its narrative. We encourage players to review this description carefully and make an informed decision before playing, especially if they are sensitive to the aforementioned themes.

row.name: Ignited Entry
row.detailed_description: You abandoned your old life as a firefighter, fleeing from the tormenting memories of a family you couldn't save from a house fire. But why do you feel like something isn't right? What is that noise? And why do I feel like it's calling me back to the house? The deeper you venture into the shadows, the more you begin to question. Is there someone waiting for me beyond the afterlife? Ignited Entry is a full length narrative driven psychological horror game with voice acting, dreamish visuals, and horror elements that will keep you on the edge of your seat.  Some doors should never be opened. row.name: 三日月　星めぐりの歌
row.detailed_description: It's a grand search game where you walk around the vast and mysterious world of stars, as if you were in a dream, collecting numerous tools, musical instruments, important items, natural objects such as minerals, fossils, and shells, and listening to the stories of the inhabitants of the stars while searching for something you've lost. The story has philosophical and spiritual elements. The landscapes of the stars are diverse, and there are nearly 1,000 maps to walk around. There are more than 200 background music songs and more than 200 sound effects made up of various musical instruments and natural sounds. In addition to wandering around looking for things, on one planet, you search for and photograph more than 2,000 species of creatures living in the natural environment (all using real-world photos of animals and plants), on another planet, you deliver many works of art such as paintings and ceramics to museums (all using photos of real artworks), on another planet, you walk through a mysterious world while listening to natural science explanations about the real world, ecosystems, and creatures. row.short_description: This is an epic search game in which you roam the vast, mysterious world of stars, like a dream, collect numerous tools, musical instruments, precious objects, and listen to stories from the inhabitants of the stars while searching for something you have lost.

row.name: Grid Tactics: Duel
row.detailed_description: The world stage is built on a universe of diverse planets, where different factions clash for colonial rights and dominance through card and tactical matchups. The worldview varies by planet, and victory depends on your construction and decisions. Every planet is a completely different worldview— Medieval Fantasy, Steampunk, Magical Civilization, Technological Hegemony, Primitive Tribes... ■ Game Features ♟ Strategy Board × Card Battle This is not a simple card matchup. The battlefield is an 8×8 strategic board , where every card played is a choice of position, timing, and resource management. You can summon units, build facilities, and deploy traps, gradually constructing your own tactical frontline. Cards feature clear and predictable effect designs, like Hearthstone and Magic: The Gathering Board layout and positioning inherit the spatial thinking of tactical games A dual-cost resource system brings deeper deckbuilding and decision-making space Complex tactics like frontline, defense, area attacks, and multi-directional selection can be freely combined Every turn is a head-on clash of strategy and anticipation. 🃏 Custom Decks, Develop Your Own Tactical Direction You can freely combine different combat strategies based on card effects, resource allocation, and board interaction. The game does not preset fixed archetypes or limit standard solutions. Every deck is a player's personal choice within the framework of rules. Differences in construction will directly affect your rhythm, resource utilization, and tactical trade-offs during the matchup. The card craft system allows you to dismantle unwanted cards to produce almost any card in the game; the pack design balances beginner experience and long-term fairness: Before the collection reaches 30 cards, drawn cards will not repeat Legendary cards feature a pity mechanism, guaranteed within a maximum of 41 draws 🌐 Real-time Online Battles / Ranked Challenges Engage in real-time battles with explorers from all over the world. You need to precisely configure the board, anticipate opponent moves, and manage resources effectively to gain an advantage in every clash. The following will be added in the future: Seasonal ranked system Specialized tactical routes Faction specialization and environmental bonus gameplay The battle situation will change, but strategic depth will only continue to stack. ■ A Work Born for Strategy Players If you love: Hearthstone Magic: The Gathering Tactical games (such as Fire Emblem , Into the Breach ) Deep deckbuilding, resource management, and long-term strategic thinking Then this strategy game, blending Cards × Board × Interstellar Exploration , will bring you a brand-new experience different from existing works.
row.short_description: Grid Tactics is a cosmic colonization adventure game that combines strategic board tactics with deck-building gameplay. Lead your expedition team as you land on diverse planets with shifting seasons, build a customized deck, and engage in tactical battles on an 8×8 grid battlefield.

row.name: Maestro Level Editor

Create Your Virtual Symphony Orchestra: Choose from multiple concert halls with unique acoustics and configure your ensemble. Use an intuitive interface with Smart Tempo tools to define conducting patterns, dynamics, and cues, designing your own symphonic challenges for the Virtual Reality game. Share via Steam Workshop: Export your creations directly to the community. Share your original compositions as simulatable concerts for others to watch, or publish challenging gameplay levels for players to conduct. It is the perfect bridge between music production and rhythm gaming. Start creating, simulating, and sharing with Maestro Level Editor and take your passion for music to the next level!

row.name: Mpirimpa
row.detailed_description: Mpirimpa / Buraco / Canasta/ Baraziliya is a free online card game which allows you to play for free with your friends and other players one Vs one or in two pairs opposing each other. The game is widely played in Greece, Italy and South America. In Italy the game is called Buraco and in South America Canasta. The game is offered in two versions, the classic Mpirimpa and Mpirimpa Pro which requires players to 'justify' taking the cards from the pot and only allows players to make melds with sequences and not identical cards. The objective of the game is to reach first the points set by the person who creates the table. Players play with chips against other players and the winners take their opponents' chips less a percentage taken from the platform. Users get free chips upon registration and they get additional free chips daily through a scratch card or daily bonus or by watching reward ads. If they run out of chips they can buy additional chips from the shop. They can also send messages to other players using our online messaging tool and can also send pictures. Players who become VIP through purchasing VIP chips are also allowed to upload their own avatar and change their user name. Players can also make friends and invite them to private tables that only them can join. Please check out our website for instructions of how to play. * By logging in, you agree to the Orderear's Terms of Service & Privacy Policy for the current website.

row.name: Virtual Towers Online
row.detailed_description: Virtual Towers Online is an unofficial free-to-play realistic, to-scale replica of the Alton Towers theme park created in the Unreal engine. It is designed to be as close as possible using architectural plans and thousands of photo references. It has been in development for over 10+ years with a very small team, allowing players to roam freely around the park riding and getting to operate some of the available attractions in the game.  Please note! This is an ongoing work-in-progress game so many features will change over time and get added or removed. There is a key shown on the maps in the game that shows which rides are available to ride and what kind of operation mode they have, for example, 'Nemesis' is fully automatic so players can ride it without interacting with it, or can take complete control to operate it, whereas 'Ripsaw' has only a manual control mode and whilst can be ridden, has no auto mode. There are likely to be bugs within the builds despite our best attempts at trying to remove any possibility of any issues you may experience however being such a small team, things get missed. It is unoptimized, we know it has a long way to go but it will take time with so few people working it, please give us a chance! The end goal is to have a multi-player environment where users from all over the world can interact with each other throughout the entire park, players can take on roles at attractions to operate it together, as well as a career mode where skills are developed while playing. Please join our Discord Server for regular updates about Virtual Towers Online and to get involved with its development.

row.name: POCKET MYSTERY EP DX
row.detailed_description: A surreal, short-form puzzle adventure / horror game built for the GameBoy, POCKET MYSTERY EP DX updates the original POCKET MYSTERY EP with full color graphics, re-designed puzzles, updated music and sound effects, and additional content. FEATURES A STRANGE MURDER:  As Detective Walker Rylance, explore the mysterious Minerva’s Nocturne hotel, investigating the locked-room murder of four colleagues. Nothing is quite as it seems, however. A COLORFUL CAST OF CHARACTERS:  Interview the colorful staff of the hotel - from the sophisticated concierge to the hyper-anxious cleaning staff and beyond. Relive the final moments of the victims and learn about who they are and their relations to each other. DESIGNED FOR THE GAMEBOY:  Built in GameBoy Studio, POCKET MYSTERY EP DX was originally built for, and is playable on, Game Boy Color. We’re not just riffing on the aesthetics of GameBoy games, this is built for the actual hardware. ESCAPE A LIMINAL SPACE:  Solve puzzles in a mysterious place seemingly inside the hotel, pushing blocks, activating switches, and more to escape a mysterious killer. DEVELOPMENT HISTORY Development of POCKET MYSTERY EP began in summer 2022 in Game Boy Studio and released about a year and a half later on Itch in December 2023. Its development was honestly frustrating and didn’t quite go as planned. Rather than giving up, the game was re-configured to try and acknowledge the difficult development.  In August 2024, with a variety of improvements and updates to Game Boy Studio, the idea to update the game, replete with GameBoy Color support, was sparked. This deluxe, or DX, re-release doesn’t aim to fully deliver on the game’s original vision, but it does seek to fix bugs, update the music and sounds, and add some additional content hinting at what might’ve been. This isn’t the end for POCKET MYSTERY EP either. A full remake, titled Nocturne: POCKET MYSTERY Remixed , is in development targeting a 2026 release.

row.detailed_description: 《怪谈事务所：破界》是一款根据同名人气剧本杀作品改编的视觉小说游戏。 这款游戏在制作中大量使用了基于AI的绘画技术和人物配音。 目前这款游戏还处于Demo阶段，您可以在游戏中体验故事的开端部分，在故事中通过自己的选择和主要人物建立最初的联系，共同应对第一个挑战。 欢迎加入万色星辰官方QQ群：116906571 我们希望您能在游玩过程中，将您对于这款基于对话选择的视觉小说类游戏的体验反馈给我们。 我们将会根据您的反馈，在将来推出的正式版中，调整不同类型部分之间的比例和游戏节奏，从而不断改善最终的游戏体验。   剧情简介： 千余年间，世间一直流传着这样一个传说：有一个不存在的组织，在掌控着这个世界所有异常。只要某种现象超出了人类现有知识体系的认知，就会被这个组织抹除。 但遗憾的是，这个组织并没有在任何史书中留有痕迹，只是在坊间被称为诡居。在欧美地区则更加隐晦的称其为“The Place”。 诡居在全球各地都有自己的分部。而到了如今的世代，圈内人开始将其据点称为事务所。 事务所的成员是由事务所分部主管亲自挑选的。不需要特定的标准、条件甚至理由。总部对于各个分部的人员挑选也不会过问。 二十年前，事务所日本分部里包括前任主管在内的大部分成员，都在一个事件中集体失踪，对整个组织造成了巨大伤害。当时唯一的幸存者悠斗先生临危受命，结下了弥补这个巨大漏洞的艰巨挑战。为此，他必须尽快补充成员，重新支撑起日本地区异常事件的监管工作。二十年间，虽然日本分部的雇员来来往往，却始终无人能让悠斗先生满意，从而做的长久。这种不稳定的运行状态甚至引起了总部的关注。 为了彻底解决团队建设的问题，又都先生力排众议，请来了六位性格各异的危险人物。 随着他们的登场，一段不为人知而又惊心动魄的故事就此拉开了帷幕……   游戏亮点： 十余张精致人物立绘 精美丰富的场景图片 优美的背景音乐和音效 主要角色对话配音 选择主角，从不同视角体验故事 通过对话分支选择，对人物关系和最终剧情走向产生影响 主要人物介绍： 秋田 算卜师，男，年龄未知，事务所顾问 传说中唯一能够通晓未来之人，却独自居住在郊外的枯屋内，除了一个瞎眼的女仆，竟然无一人作伴。 无人知晓他的年纪，而关于他的传说，却从来都没有中断过。传说他出现之时，便是大灾降临的预兆。   醉牙 变形者，男，35岁，事务所正式成员 没有人见过他真实的容貌，据说连他自己也忘记了。 他从未透露过自己的身世，眼神中总是充满憎恨，却养了一屋子的猫猫狗狗，和各种小动物，实在是和他壮硕的身材，凶狠的目光极为不符。 有人见过他到底能变形成什么样子么?问得好，见过的人，似乎都死了。   云落 阴阳师，男，34岁，事务所新人 作为甲辽一族的传人，拥有能与百年前的十大阴阳师相媲美的天赋，肩负着重振甲辽一族的使命。 但是也有人质疑，一个甘愿去当高中英文老师的阴阳师，如何才能担起如此重任呢? 因此，族内也有一些罢黜云落的声音出现，但云落对一切明争暗斗都只是付之一笑。   桑娜 格斗家，女，28岁，事务所正式成员 五年前，突然出现在日本境内的美国人，专职保镖。她很快便在一次保护三木组老大的暴力冲突中，以一敌面，一战成名，身价飞升。 她对于自己的过去守口如瓶。虽然身为保镖，但她从不带枪，声称这是对人体最大的侮辱，鬼知道她在想什么。   川子 通灵师，女，25岁，事务所新人 常年在由东和电器财团赞助的精神病院中生活，只是偶尔会在委托事件中离开病院。她的真实身份没有人知道，请她解决事件的委托人们更是身份神秘。 毕竟普通人是不会相信通灵这种技能的，更何况使用者是一个疯子，一个爱笑的疯子。 广羽 人偶师，女，28岁，事务所新人 自从末代人偶师良野死后，所有人都以为人偶这个古老的技艺已经失传了，而广羽的出现改变了一切。 她不但继承了良野的人偶术，还利用各种高科技手段加以改造。 同时，她提出了很多方法来实现人偶的商业价值。其中最成功的项目，就是大规模的人偶舞台巡演。 广羽迅速扩展的商业集团使她跻身到了日本的富豪榜的前十，因而赢得了“人偶金矿”的美称。 但她却在一年前突然变卖家产，销声匿迹，只留下一个让人津津乐道的都市传说。

As your snake grows, it becomes harder to avoid your own body, and the increasing speed adds to the difficulty. With its nostalgic gameplay, easy-to-learn controls, and challenging progression, Snake King offers endless hours of fun. Can you beat your high score and become the ultimate Snake King?
row.short_description: Snake King is a modern twist on the classic Snake game. Guide your snake through an open arena, eating fruit to grow longer while avoiding walls and your own tail. Simple to play, with increasing speed and difficulty—challenge yourself to beat your high score and become the Snake King!

row.name: UWAR
row.detailed_description: UWAR is a new, thrilling multiplayer shooter that transports players into modern combat based on real events. The game focuses on the conflict between Ukraine and Russia, giving players the chance to test themselves on the front lines. Locations like Koksohim, Irpin, and Serebryansk Forest recreate real battle zones, immersing players in dynamic operations of capturing positions, destroying ammunition depots, and fighting for strategic advantage. UWAR offers seven unique game modes, each testing players' tactical skills and providing a varied gaming experience: Conquest: Capture key points on the map to bring your team closer to victory. Rush: Attack or defend objectives, using a limited reinforcement pool. Kill Confirmed: Take down opponents and collect their tags to score points. Team Deathmatch: A classic mode focused on kill count. Capture The Flag: Steal the enemy’s flag and return it to your base. Free For All: Compete for the highest score in a “every player for themselves” format. Search and Destroy: Destroy objectives with only one life per round. UWAR is more than just a game. It honors the courage and resilience of people in challenging times. By purchasing the game, you support a project that connects players to real events in modern history, making a valuable contribution to the development of the military shooter genre.
row.short_description: UWAR is a game about the conflict between Ukraine and Russia, where players can capture territories, control artillery, FPV drones, and vehicles on real battle maps in the game!

row.name: TCG Master Trader
row.detailed_description: TCG Master Trader is a free to play card-collecting experience where every few hours brings new surprises and new cards to discover! Real Time Based Drops Every 4 hours, players can claim a fresh pack of 5 random cards, added straight to their personal collection. Card drops are real time-based , meaning the timer counts down even while the game is closed — you don’t need to be online or actively playing. Just come back to claim your rewards… or enable Auto-Claim to receive your packs automatically! During special events or promotions, drop intervals may change or include bonus packs. To be the first to know when that happens, join our official Discord community . Card Collection & Binder Card Binder: Dive into your binder to browse your collection, examine your cards, and enjoy the unique designs and visual styles of each pull. There are 144 unique base cards , but with multiple styles, borders, and foils, there’s a total of 1,728 cards to collect, and more to come ! Drop Rates & Customization Each pack contains 5 randomly generated cards with a random rarity, border, foil and art type. Here’s what you can expect: Card Rarities: Common – 70% Uncommon – 20.71% Rare – 8.28% Epic – 1% Legendary – 0.01% Border Styles: Basic – 80% Gold – 17% Radiant – 3% Art Versions: Standard – 90% Full Art – 10% Foil Variants: Non-Foiled – 95% Foiled – 5% Marketplace Freedom All cards in your collection can be listed on the Steam Community Market! You can freely buy and sell cards with other players to build your binder, hunt for rare variants, or simply manage your growing collection however you like. Key Highlights • Free card packs every 4 hours – Always something new to look forward to. • Fully interactive card binder – Organize, admire, and display your collection. • Deep customization possibilities – Rarities, borders, art styles, and foils. • Steam Market integration – Buy and sell with players worldwide. • 1,728 collectible card variations – Will you collect them all? row.short_description: Claim a free pack of cards every few hours and expand your collection! Discover hundreds of unique cards with different styles, rarities, and visual effects.

row.name: Liquidator
row.detailed_description: Play this game and you'll realize that everything you knew about HELL was actually PARADISE. 'LIQUIDATOR' will shed light on the true state of events. You'll even get to choose the paths you take to Hell, there are three of them. All of them are similar to the post-perestroika era. Each one has many stages and even more monsters. Tear them apart and taste their blood... and don't forget the secret tilde kick!
row.short_description: 'LIQUIDATOR' will shed light on the true state of events.

row.name: Conscience
row.detailed_description: Conscience is a noir detective mystery where you play as a private investigator hired to uncover the truth behind Jack Beckham's death. Initially ruled as a suicide, Jack’s father believes otherwise and hires you to search Jack’s apartment for clues to reveal what really happened. Investigate and explore Jack’s apartment, searching every room, shelf, and drawer for evidence and clues. Inspect the evidence , uncovering hidden details and piecing together crucial clues. Deduce  what truly happened using the clues you’ve gathered to solve the mystery. Solve the Mystery...
row.short_description: Jack Beckham is found dead, hanging in his apartment alone. Police rule it a suicide. His father, refusing to accept the conclusion, hires you to investigate. Delve into the clues left behind in his apartment to discover what really happened.

row.name: MojiCraft
row.detailed_description: Welcome to MojiCraft! Build up your army of Mojis and lead them into tactical battles! MojiCraft is a turn-based real-time strategy game with a minimalistic playstyle. Perfect for players who enjoy tactical games without a steep learning curve. Play casually with friends or show off your mastery by crafting unstoppable strategies.  Choose Your Faction There are a variety of factions, each with its own unique playstyle. Whether you're playing as the adaptable Humans, the fierce Beasts, or the sneaky Critters, there's a faction for everyone. Each one brings something different to the table, and figuring out how to make the most of your chosen faction is part of the fun! Lead Your Army To Victory Adaptability and tactical precision are key to victory. Start off by commanding one Moji from your faction and build up your structures and resources to produce even more Mojis. Fend off enemy attacks and send Mojis into battles of attrition or go all-in! Adjust your tactics to destroy all the structures of your enemies and claim victory.
row.short_description: MojiCraft is a minimal turn-based real-time strategy game where you build an army of Mojis and lead them into tactical battles. Choose from multiple unique factions, manage your resources, and claim victory by outsmarting your opponents and adapting your strategy to destroy their territory.

row.name: Steel Skirmish Reloaded: Online Multiplayer Tank Shooter Playtest
Endless Defense: Survival

Face endless waves of monsters, equip weapons, upgrade the tower soul to harvest the horde, and gather resources to upgrade your tower and soul. Dual-wield your tower and soul to defeat bosses and experience the ultimate thrill of endless mowing. Variety and Depth, Never Gets Boring With nearly a hundred unique weapons and upgrade effects, enjoy the thrill of mowing down enemies while stacking top-tier roguelike experiences, ensuring each battle delivers double the excitement. Balance your weapon combinations and upgrade effects to optimize offense and defense, allowing for infinite mowing and stress relief. Tower and Soul Synergy, United We Stand Explore the abyss to gather soul stones and enhance your tower soul for combat assistance. Whether dual-wielding with separate attack paths or merging them into the ultimate defense tower, you'll experience the ultimate mowing thrill. Adapt and Conquer, Master the Elements Against different enemies, remember the counter rules: Metal crushes medium armor; Piercing counters light armor; Magic defeats heavy armor; Siege breaks reinforced armor; Chaos weapons treat all equally, ignoring armor! row.short_description: This is a innovative roguelike TD game made with the 『CliCli』. No need for path planning or tower combos—just one tower! With almost 100 weapons, you’ll be mowing down foes and dominating the battlefield. Enjoy the rush and let off some steam!

row.name: Escape The Office VR
row.detailed_description: Today is the day you finally break free from that toxic work environment!.....or is it? row.name: Lami: A Cup of Code & Coffee Playtest
Slice, Suffer, Serve!
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Most Haunted Restaurant in Town! In Slice, Suffer, Serve! , you’ve just landed the most unique job of your afterlife, serving ghostly customers at a restaurant. But they’re not known for their patience!— Slice up human ingredients and serve ghostly customers before they get too angry. Get ready for a fast-paced, fun, and strange cooking game where you have to stay calm under pressure and keep your ghost customers happy. Make too many mistakes, and the ghosts might just haunt you! Key Features Midnight Madness : You’ll be serving from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM, because, of course, ghosts like to eat at night! Fast-Paced Fun : Quickly slice and serve while keeping your kitchen running smoothly under pressure. Can you manage the chaos before time runs out? Four Chances : Ghosts are forgiving... to a point. You can afford a few slip-ups, but anger them too much and you’ll face the consequences. Make four mistakes, and it’s game over. High Scores : Think you can make the perfect dish under pressure? Challenge yourself to earn the highest score, beating the clock and out-serving your ghostly competition. Only the best chefs can survive the night! What You Can Expect Unique Gameplay: Slice, Suffer, Serve! is a fast-paced slice-and-click game where you play as a chef preparing dishes from human body parts to serve ghostly customers. As orders pile up, the pressure builds, and you’ll need to stay sharp to avoid losing points. Replayability: Every playthrough is a fresh challenge. With a focus on speed, accuracy, and quick thinking, you’ll have the chance to beat your personal high score each time you play. No two rounds are exactly the same! Tension and Strategy: You get four chances to make mistakes, but once you reach your limit, the night ends. You’ll need to plan carefully, react quickly, and keep your cool under growing pressure to succeed. Stylized Horror Setting with Folklore: The game’s spooky, haunted restaurant is brought to life with quirky, cartoonish visuals and eerie sound effects. Ghost customers from different countries and folklore add variety and keep the experience fresh and exciting. Mature Content Description This game includes cartoonish depictions of violence, such as slicing human body parts to serve as food to ghostly customers. While the art style is light-hearted and exaggerated, the game features themes of death and gore, which may not be suitable for all audiences.
row.short_description: Slice, Suffer, Serve! is a 2D slice-and-click game where you play as a chef, preparing dishes for ghost customers. Sell as many dishes as possible and try not to let the customers get angry! What are you waiting for, new employee? Serve spooky dishes to ghostly guests—quickly!!!
row.reviews: “Great game! A very complete package! Great concept, great execution, great sense of humor, great fun! Im really impressed with how it all came together. I think that's one of the hardest and most impressive things you can do in games (or any medium) is when everything fits together so well. The combination of Fruit Ninja + serving was really clever. And the way you get different items from slashing different parts of the body was great. And it was so intuitive which customers would want which item (Vampire = blood from the neck, zombies = brain from the head, and my favorite was the Krasue who wants poop lol). And the final twist of different levels of decay added more challenge without making the game more complex to understand. Everything was very intuitive. I think if you spend some more time polishing the game you could have a small hit on your hands! Really impressive work! I hope you all keep making games together!” Art-eater
row.notes: Slice, Suffer, Serve! features cartoonish depictions of violence, where players will slice human body parts to prepare meals for ghostly customers. The game’s visual style is exaggerated and not realistic, but the themes of death, dismemberment, and gore are present throughout gameplay. There are no depictions of sexual acts, drug/alcohol abuse, self-harm, or any other sensitive topics like sexual assault or non-consensual acts. However, the violence and themes of death may be unsettling for some players.

row.name: Ika's Odyssey
row.detailed_description: Join Ika and the Creature on their season-spanning trek through the Migration Path! This colorful puzzle-platformer features 60 levels of puzzle-box challenges that are sure to test your wit -- and your platforming abilities! Set in the serene nature of a post-post-apocalyptic American countryside, this world has long forgotten humanity -- until Ika the Woodpecker discovers a lone child on his trek south for the Winter. CONTROLLER RECOMMENDED! - All common controllers are supported. OUR HEROES Ika was the Captain of his flock - an ace flyer, skilled archer, and role model for the fledglings under his tutelage. Days before his flock's annual migration, he was severely injured on a scouting mission, resulting in the loss of his left wing. Flightless, he was abandoned by his people as they fled Winter's bitter grasp. On his unprecedented perilous trek, Ika discovers a child of an unfamiliar breed. He quickly finds the Creature is capable of magical feats, allowing him to progress far further than he ever could alone. Alone, they are powerless. But together, the duo can surmount any obstacle in their way. ABILITIES Ika serves as the duo's muscle -- he is responsible for the platforming and item use in the game. While his loss of a wing resulted in his inability to fly, he can still jump and use his good wing to clear obstacles. The Creature is nimble and dexterous -- he is able to climb vines to reach greater heights and can fit in small spaces. But his small stature means he's unable to jump, and his weak arms prevent him from using the items that the duo craft. When the duo is united, they unlock the ability to craft items by combining the items they possess. Ika and the Creature can each hold one item, and combining them allows them to craft a new item to overcome obstacles in their path. There are dozens of combinations to discover and experiment with! The Creature has magical abilities that allow him to channel the things he eats into elemental power - use this ability wisely! Wielding the elements results in many new possible items to craft. Try to find all the combinations! SPEED IS KEY Every level will give you a Star Ranking depending on how fast you beat it. This puts your puzzling abilities and your reflexes to the test to truly show your mastery! Enable the Timer in Options to keep track of your Star Progress in real time. Play your fastest to unlock every Star! P.S. My best speedrun of the game is 56:26, try to beat that! FEATURES 60 Unique Puzzle-box Levels 12 Worlds, each concluding with a narrative diary entry Single Player Campaign lasting ~4-5 hours Support for all common controllers (Xbox, Playstation, Switch Pro Controller, Steam Deck, and many more) 7 Achievements 8 Original Songs Dozens of Item Combinations Sound and Display Settings Level Select for honing speedrun times Quick Retry to perfect individual levels This is the debut title from solo-developer Dongle Duck. No generative AI was used in the creation of this game.
row.short_description: Before his flock's migration, Ika the Woodpecker lost his ability to fly. He is forced to do the impossible - walk the migration path. Hope emerges when he discovers a magical child of a long extinct species. Craft, climb, and solve puzzles to overcome obstacles as a duo in this puzzle-platformer.

row.name: Flipper Frenzy
row.detailed_description: This is a racing game. With seals. You flop on land, you glide in water, and you try to win. That’s it. No ancient prophecies. No world to save. Just you, a seal, and the finish line. At its core, Flipper Frenzy is a physics-driven racing game where awkward movement is half the challenge. On land, you’ll galumph, flop, and slide like you’re late for an appointment. But once you hit the water, you suddenly transform into a sleek aquatic powerhouse. Race alone, challenge your friends in split-screen, or go online for a splash of unpredictable chaos. The current version has racing, customizable seals, multiplayer, and several unique tracks—each with its own strange flavor (like dystopian seal worlds and sky tubes). But that’s just the start. As development continues, expect new game modes, seal parkour, obstacle courses, PVP battles, and a growing roster of pinnipeds to play as. If that sounds like something you'd be into, jump in. The water’s fine. Key Features 🦭 Seal Racing (Obviously) Race seals. Flop on land. Glide in water. Master both to win. It's harder than it sounds. 🎮 Multiplayer Mayhem Compete with friends or strangers. Play online or split-screen with local co-op. Win gracefully or flop furiously. 🎉 Customizable Seals Choose your seal’s colors, patterns, and general 'vibe.' If you're going to finish last, at least do it with style. 🌎 Authentic Tracks (Not Reskinned Templates) No 'lava world' or 'ice world' clones here. Each track is designed to feel distinct, memorable, and (sometimes) confusing in the best way possible. Current tracks include: Foggy Lighthouse Island – Mysterious and damp. Frozen Glaciers – Cold. Slippery. As expected. Tropical Oasis – Tropical, but somehow still challenging. Sky Tubes – Gravity? What's that? Seal Dystopia – Weird, unsettling, and full of questions. What’s on the Horizon? With enough support, Flipper Frenzy could grow into more than just a racing game. Here are some of the bigger goals I’m aiming for: 🏁 Seal Parkour Showdowns Navigate chaotic obstacle courses filled with jumps, flops, and wild physics. Outlast the competition to be the last seal standing. ⚔️ PVP Arena Battles No racing. Just seals going head-to-head in flop-to-flop combat. Knock, bash, and belly-slam your way to dominance in chaotic arenas. 🏐 Seal Sports Volleyball, dodgeball, and maybe a few other sports that seals probably shouldn’t be playing—but they will anyway. 🦭 Social Seal Lobbies A dedicated space for seals to gather, group up, and queue for races. Show off your customized seal, chat with other players, and prepare for the next big event. More Tracks & Seals – These Are Happening Some things aren’t 'stretch goals'—they're just part of the plan. Game Items  & Abilities – In addition to seals and tracks, I’m looking to add game-changing items and abilities that keep every race unpredictable. More Tracks – No lazy reskins. Each track will have its own distinct theme, layout, and memorable moments. No “lava version of the grass track” nonsense here. More Seals to Play As – Right now, you’ve got harbor, ringed, harp, and ribbon seals. But with time, the roster will expand to include: Leopard Seals – Big. Powerful. The kind of seal you don’t mess with. Weddell Seals – Quiet. Mysterious. The seal that definitely knows something . Elephant Seals – Loud. Massive. Impossible to miss. Sea Lions – Not technically seals, but they’re in the family, so they get a pass. What Makes This Game Different? You know how most racing games have an 'ice world' or 'lava world' that’s just a reskinned version of the grass track? This isn’t that. Tracks in Flipper Frenzy are designed to feel distinct—not like they were slapped together with the same pieces but in different colors. Foggy islands, upside-down sky tubes, and weird seal dystopias are the kind of places you'll race. It’s also not a 'modern gaming experience.' No battle passes. No premium fish coins. No FOMO countdowns. You buy it, you play it. Updates bring more content, not 'exclusive offers.' And if you stop playing for a while, no one will spam your inbox with 'we miss you' emails. Honestly, I’m too old to understand half that stuff anyway. I grew up on Nintendo—where you bought a game, played it, and that was it. That’s the vibe I’m going for here. Who’s Making This Game? It’s just me. I’m a solo developer, which means I wear all the hats—coding, hand-modeling, animating the seals, and building most of the levels from scratch. No asset flips. No third-party 'content packs.' Okay, there are some store-bought assets. I’m not a wizard. But most of it is handmade, from the awkward waddle physics to the tracks that (hopefully) don’t feel like they were pulled from a Unity starter kit. This project started as a bit of a hobby, but like a little wooden toy hoping to become something more, I’m hoping it can grow into a real game . If you like what you see, maybe you can help make this thing a reality. For now, it’s a racing game. With seals. Flipper Frenzy was developed using the Unreal® Engine. Unreal® is a trademark or registered trademark of Epic Games, Inc. in the United States of America and elsewhere.
row.short_description: Flop, slide, and splash your way to victory in Flipper Frenzy—the seal-iest racing game ever! Customize your seal, gallumph on land, and zoom through water in wild tracks like frozen glaciers, tropical oases, and sky-high tubes. Play solo, online, or local co-op and seal the win! 🦭

row.name: Potion Problems
row.detailed_description: Potion Problems A chaotic social deduction party game for 4–10 players set in a whimsical world of magic and mischief. Welcome to Pigeonpoint’s College for Potion Making, where not everything is as it seems. In Potion Problems , players are secretly divided into two teams—Apprentices and Troublemakers—and must either follow the rules or stir up magical mayhem. Who will brew, and who will betray? Apprentices craft unique potions and work toward meeting their potion quota. Troublemakers use the forbidden Frog Potion to transform apprentices into frogs and derail their progress. When a frog is found, the group votes on who they think is responsible. Accuse wisely—your closest ally might be the one causing all the trouble. Key Features: Multiplayer Mayhem: Supports 4 to 10 players online or over local connection Secret Roles: Collaborate or deceive depending on your hidden identity Strategic Deduction: Gather clues, build trust, and figure out who’s working against you Whimsical Setting: Explore a colorful, magical campus full of surprises High Replayability: New dynamics every round keep the gameplay fresh Win Conditions: Apprentices win by completing their potion quota before too many are turned into frogs, or if they vote out all the troublemakers. Troublemakers win if the majority of apprentices are transformed into frogs. Blend strategy, social deception, and magical chaos in Potion Problems —where every game is a bubbling mix of suspense and fun.
row.short_description: Potion Problems is a multiplayer party game, combining social deduction and magic. Navigate Pigeonpoint's College for Potion Making as a troublemaker or an apprentice. Collect ingredients, make potions, avoid being turned into a frog, and vote out troublemakers to complete your degree!
