row.detailed_description: PlanetX is a real-time strategy MMO that redefines large-scale multiplayer warfare. The battle begins on Planet Alpha , where dozens of players start with seven land plots each. Unlike traditional flat maps, the entire game takes place on a fully spherical planet , adding an extra layer of strategy to territorial expansion. Players must build and expand their empire , constructing various structures and managing resources. The first challenge is achieving a perfect balance between resource extraction and production to fuel economic growth. Once a player amasses enough wealth, it's time to assemble a powerful army , featuring tanks, aircraft, and missiles . A unique aspect of PlanetX is its energy-based warfare  - tanks and aircraft are fully electric , requiring charging stations before heading into battle. Units will fight until they run out of energy or are destroyed , making strategic deployment and resource management crucial. The ultimate goal? Total planetary domination. The first player to conquer every available land plot on Planet Alpha claims victory and earns a ticket to Planet Beta , where even greater challenges await. As multiple Alpha champions arrive on Beta, the war escalates to an entirely new level. Everything in PlanetX  -  construction, battles, resource trading, and land deals - happens in real time , ensuring a fast-paced, dynamic experience. Do you have what it takes to rise as the supreme ruler of the galaxy?
row.short_description: PlanetX is a real-time strategy MMO set on a spherical planet. Players expand territories, construct buildings, and manage resources to develop their empire. The ultimate goal is to conquer the entire planet by claiming all land plots and outpacing rivals in strategic growth and domination.

row.name: Popo & Rob
row.detailed_description: About This Game Popo & Rob is a team-based first-person shooter designed for quick, thrilling matches in a vibrant, colorful world that redefines freedom of movement. Featuring two unique factions—Popo and Rob—the game pits players against each other in battles where every match feels fresh, thanks to fully explorable environments with surfaces you can walk on from any orientation. Key Features Freedom of Movement Forget what you know about gravity! In Popo & Rob , players can walk, run, and fight on any surface they see, opening up a myriad of strategic possibilities. You’re not limited to just the ground—rooftops, walls, and every possible angle are fair game. Diverse Characters and Skills Each character in Popo & Rob comes with a unique skill set and gun type, letting you approach battles with a play style that suits you best. Some characters may be more tactical, while others are all about direct firepower, giving players plenty of choices. Casual-Friendly, Yet Challenging While Popo & Rob is easy for newcomers to pick up, it also offers layers of depth for FPS veterans. The simple controls and streamlined mechanics ensure accessibility, but mastering each character’s skills and movement across varying surfaces adds a level of challenge. Colorful, Anime-Inspired Aesthetic The game’s aesthetic draws from anime and fun, stylized visuals reminiscent of games like Splatoon. Every map is filled with vibrant colors and bold designs that keep gameplay visually engaging and inviting. Pick Your Faction, Play Your Way Will you side with the fun-loving Popo or the resourceful Rob? Each faction offers its own style and strategies, creating a distinct identity that sets up every match as a playful clash of styles. Join the world of Popo & Rob for endless FPS fun, coming this December on Steam.
row.short_description: Popo & Rob is an action-packed shooter game that combines dynamic, casual-friendly shooting with a unique twist on movement. Engage in exciting battles where gravity is no limit. Choose your side, Popo or Rob, and immerse yourself in a world that’s bright, bold, and brimming with fun.

row.name: Zone-0
row.detailed_description: About This Game Zone-0 was created in just one week as a showcase of our free, publicly available Unreal Engine framework. This short horror experience was built to demonstrate how quickly and effectively developers can build immersive worlds with it — and we challenged ourselves to push its capabilities to the limit. Story It was supposed to be a quiet goodbye. You’re just a low-clearance guard posted at the front gate of a sprawling facility no one talks about. For years, you watched people come and go—never knowing what went on behind the reinforced walls. Now the project is being shut down. Decommissioned. Stripped for parts and packed away like it never existed. But on your final shift, something goes wrong. The ground shakes. Pipes burst. Sirens wail in. Whatever was buried in the dark isn’t staying quiet. You were never meant to see what’s inside. But now, there’s no turning back. Features Atmospheric Exploration Navigate flickering tunnels, broken labs, and looping corridors. The deeper you go the more you start to understand. Minimalist Horror Mechanics No combat. Just immersive, sound-driven tension, environmental interaction, and storytelling. Immersive Audio & Design

row.name: Olympia: Festival of the Gods
row.detailed_description: Olympia: Festival of the Gods  is a digital board game where players collect tokens in order to perform rituals to honor the Gods of Ancient Greece! Players can compete against other players in local PVP, or against AI bots. Note:  Olympia: Festival of the Gods does not  support online multiplayer at this time. This feature may be added in a future update. HOW TO PLAY The game is composed of 6 rounds. Each round honors a different Greek God or Goddess. Each round is broken up into two phases: collecting, and scoring. During the Collecting phase, players compete to collect their desired tokens. Players collect all of the tokens of the same color from either columns or the table. Tokens belonging to the God or Goddess that is being honored that round are 'wild' allowing one additional token to be collected with any other tokens. But watch out for the Hades token at the table center -- collecting Hades will cost players valuable points! During the Scoring phase, players use their tokens on ritual spaces at a God or Goddess's altar. Each ritual has a cost - the player must spend tokens of the designated color (or the wild color) to complete the ritual. Completing all of the rituals of a particular God or Goddess rewards the player with bonus points!

row.name: Project Search
row.detailed_description: Project Search is an atmospheric visual novel inspired by Chinese science fiction and Daoist cultivation of immortality. Set in the spectral landscapes of Linhai, Chongqing, and Dunhuang, the game invites players to explore parallel dimensions, ancient grotto-heavens, and transcendental urban spaces. Character and Plot The protagonist, Qian Jiangmin, is a young scholar recovering from illness searching for his brother. His journey gradually reveals hidden grotto-heavens and mysteries about his double vision, propelling him toward self-discovery and transcendence. You will take on the role of Qian Jiangmin with his HMD (head-mounted display) and drone, a young researcher on a quest to find his brother. Guided by scholars and Daoist cultivators, you will explore the mysterious underground realms hidden within Linhai's old town. How to Play Navigate using WASD and arrow keys , with Shift to speed up and Enter to access a bird's-eye view of the level. Use the  Spacebar  to switch levels, and press and hold  i to inspect specific NPCs and locations. Press R to restart the level. Throughout your journey, approach and interact with dodecahedron objects and hidden features, activated by mouse hovering or clicking, to dive deeper into the lore. Non-linear Exploration Designed to be non-linear with no compulsory objectives, Project Search emphasises exploration and discovery. You can switch to 14 levels anytime. Players are encouraged to wander, uncover hidden artefacts, and piece together the city's incompleteness, imperfection, and picturesqueness. There are no fixed goals—just the thrill of curiosity and adventure. Sandstorm Dunhuang Project Search transports players to Dunhuang's ordinary yet metaphysical streets, a significant religious city with ancient cultural heritage in China's far northwest. You will experience the rhythms of everyday life while uncovering deeper spiritual and historical layers. Foggy Chongqing Another scene in the game is set in Chongqing, capturing the constant rain, mist, and post-industrial feel of the district adjacent to the Sichuan Fine Arts Institute. This environment adds a hauntingly surreal atmosphere, blending art with the urban landscape. Non-collision Linhai Most Project Search unfolds in the old town of Linhai, Taizhou, in Zhejiang province. This setting forms an urban techno-fantasy that links Chinese Daoist philosophies with modern technology, offering a spectral and uncanny vision for players to reflect Chinese cultural heritage. An Auto-ethnography Each level in Project Search combines art, myth, and contemplation, creating an immersive experience. This encourages players to distinctly personalise their reflections on spirituality, cultural heritage, and modernity. Shared Universe with HyperBody Project Search is set in the same universe as the HyperBody VR game and shares NPCs and specific environments. Fans of HyperBody will enjoy exploring connections at the Garden Portal level, which provides an extended immersive experience across both games.
row.short_description: Project Search is a visual novel of Chinese immortality cultivation. Scholar Qian Jiangmin investigates collapsed pagodas in Linhai's old town while searching for his missing brother. With the help of Daoist cultivators, he explores grotto-heavens and uncovers the truth behind his double vision.
row.reviews: “Integrating design techniques such as non-collision, mistiness, and imperfection based on ethnographic studies in Project Search creates an emotionally rich and culturally immersive experience for players.” DiGRA 2023 Conference

Set in a rich fantasy/medieval world, players must gather gold and progress their skills to fight against their opponents. As a novice of The Order, you start at the bottom rung of the ladder. However, through your faith and dedication, you can discover new skills and abilities that allow you to overpower your rivals and climb the ranks of The Order. You must choose whether to rely on their wits and skills alone, embrace your belligerent side, or use your dedication to deter potential attackers. But be warned, you can only attack those of a lower rank than you. Eventually, you will hit a plateau and find it difficult to progress further. However, among the ranks of The Order, you may discover a way to start over while retaining some of your power to progress even faster than before. This adds an extra layer of strategy to the game, as you must balance short-term gains with long-term planning.

row.name: In The Night You Had Bad Dreams
row.detailed_description: In the Night You Had Bad Dreams is a first-person horror game. A strange house within your dreams seems to twist and change, waiting for you to solve unconventional puzzles. You simply need to find the key and open the door. If you find enough keys and open enough doors, maybe the nightmare will end. 'Ever since I moved into this house, I've had weird dreams. For the first few months, I thought it was the stress of adapting to a new place. Two years have passed now , and I still get this strange feeling -like someone is watching me in my sleep. Like I'm not alone in this house. I feel tired all the time. Sometimes I get lost in my own house. The doctors say I'm fine. Therapy doesn't work. I'm so tired.' This game is my first project as a solo developer , and I have decided to release it for free as a gesture of gratitude towards the game development community. They have played a crucial role in making this project a reality through tons of tutorials, support forums, and free assets available online. Although I acknowledge that it is not flawless, I simply wanted to contribute something and hope that people find enjoyment in the experience.

row.name: Undercover
row.detailed_description: About This Game You are a knight honorable, brave, and bound to the kingdom. But this is no ordinary day in the realm. As dawn breaks over the medieval kingdom, you and your fellow knights prepare to uphold your duties: to patrol the forests, guard the castle gates, and protect the people. Each knight stands by your side, sworn to the same codes of loyalty and valor. Or so you thought… But whispers have spread across the realm. Under you walks an infiltrator, hiding behind a knight’s armor and waiting for the right moment to strike. This imposter, clever and ruthless, has one goal—to dismantle the Order from within and carry out a dark mission. Trust begins to crumble as you look to your comrades with suspicion. The question haunts every conversation, every glance: Who is the undercover infiltrator hiding under us? A Journey of Suspicion and Survival Your quest will take you deep into the heart of this medieval world, across winding forest trails and bustling village streets. Each day brings a series of duties: you’ll defend villagers from outlaws, protect royal secrets, and, above all, stay vigilant for any sign of betrayal. As you carry out these noble tasks, every word spoken and action taken by those around you takes on a new, ominous weight. But the infiltrator is cunning. They blend in, playing the role of a loyal knight, all while weaving distrust, watching your every move, and waiting to strike. Your choices could mean the difference between victory and defeat, honor and disgrace. Do You Dare to Trust? In Undercover , trust is the rarest currency. As you move through this medieval world, each decision, each word, and each glance could be your last. Gather your courage, ready your sword, and remember—true honor lies not just in victory, but in survival.
row.short_description: In Undercover, you enter a medieval world as a noble knight among trusted comrades. But beware—one of you is an infiltrator with a deadly mission. While you carry out your knightly duties, deception and danger lurk in the shadows. Can you unmask the traitor before they strike?

row.name: Blend_IT
row.detailed_description: Blend_It is a minimalist, comfortable puzzle game. Your goal is to combine the simple figures provided to fit the images presented. a puzzle game with a new mechanism Blend_It is a game that uses only black and white colors. White has a value of 1, and black has a value of 0. You can edit the combination by selecting shapes, selecting multiplication, addition, and subtraction operations. Think of colors as numbers, use operators, layering shapes to create new shapes! a constant challenge There are currently a total of 100 stages for Blend_It. (We're still updating it.) If you have completed the 100th stage, the infinite mode created by AI will be lifted. Experience new stages constantly through Infinite Mode!
row.short_description: Blend_It gives players a simple black-and-white image. The image has a value of 1 for white and 0 for black. These color values are combined through three operators: multiplication, addition, and subtraction Make it a more complex image!

row.name: 1X1
row.detailed_description: This is someone's lab and factory, full of dangerous things. You're a lost little soul here. Survive the obstacle, finish the boss that comes out of the door and move on! 'The door opens' 1X1 is largely divided into a barrage and a boss battle, and the game is played. Normally the door is closed, but as you work through the pattern and move on, the door opens and you encounter the boss of that stage. If the door opens, prepare for a battle with the boss! 'The door is closing' Give the boss schedule damage and he closes the door and runs away. The later barrage patterns and battles come back stronger. Key Features It consists of patterns of various personalities as well as 'avoid bullets.' You can have fun switching between passive avoidance and active combat. Meet the robotic design to fit the theme of factory and robot Each boss has a simple method of targeting that can be operated with one button. It is not easy, but you can enjoy it without burden with checkpoints that occur every time you open and close the door. There is an infinite bomb stage for those who want to focus on bomb shelters without fighting.
row.short_description: Become a little soul lost in a dangerous factory, avoid obstacles and battle bosses. A challenging bullet hell game where you advance by opening and closing doors!

row.name: Lifetakers & Heartbreakers
row.detailed_description: 'Lifters & Heartbreakers' is an intense 2D side-scrolling shooter set in the war-torn world of Pavlovia. Players follow the harrowing journey of three elite soldiers from the Hunter Unit— Lynch , Hirschmann , and Bishop —who must fight for their survival after their helicopter crash-lands deep within enemy territory. Stranded behind enemy lines, they soon uncover a deadly plot: a rebel faction led by the cunning Pavlovian sniper officer Sasha is on the brink of deploying a nuclear weapon. As players navigate through hostile terrain, they must rely on quick reflexes and tactical skill to overcome waves of enemies, sabotage rebel operations, and stop the nuclear threat before it’s too late. With fast-paced combat, unique character abilities, and a gripping narrative set against the backdrop of a global conflict, 'Lifters & Heartbreakers' delivers a thrilling gameplay experience where every bullet counts. Can you outsmart Sasha and his forces, and prevent the ultimate disaster?
row.short_description: 'Lifetakers & Heartbreakers' is an intense 2D side-scrolling shooter set in the war-torn world of Pavlovia.

row.name: Valsa das Macaúbas
row.detailed_description: Step Into the Dance of Time - Relive Porto Nacional in 1917 In a Brazil of another era, where faith, traditions, and mysteries intertwine, you are invited to embark on a unique journey. Valsa das Macaúbas is not just a game – it’s an immersion into history, through cobblestone streets and secrets that echo within the walls of Porto Nacional. Get ready to uncover the unexpected and dance between the real and the fantastical Conversations that connect you to the mystery Explore Three Mystery-Filled Locations Between light and shadow, explore Caetanato , Catacombs , and Church . 🕯️ Features A Story Set in the Heart of Old Brazil Explore a dark narrative inspired by legends, mysteries, and memories from the countryside of northern Goiás (now Tocantins), with environments that evoke a forgotten time — from ancient churches and stifling catacombs to the enigmatic Caetanato. Puzzles and Secrets Lurking in the Shadows Solve environmental puzzles that block your path, interact with objects, and uncover hidden clues. Each puzzle reveals a new piece of the past and helps you understand the story more deeply. A World Between the Real and the Supernatural Face environments filled with symbolism and psychological tension. Light and darkness dance in every scene, and there is always more than meets the eye. Dangerous Encounters Not everything along your journey is meant to be understood — some encounters require silence, escape, or bravery. Stay alert and prepare to face what lurks in the shadows. Original Soundtrack and Immersive Atmosphere From religious chants to mysterious arrangements, the soundtrack of Valsa das Macaúbas accompanies every step with sounds that echo from the earth, the spirit, and memory itself.
row.short_description: A third-person narrative adventure game that blends exploration, puzzle-solving, and impactful choices. Players investigate mysteries, interact with characters, and make decisions that shape the course of the story, immersing them in a journey between the real and the supernatural.

row.name: Dumbriel: Magnificent Adventure in Hell Playtest
Teddy Knight
row.detailed_description: Long forgotten in the depths of the toy chest, Teddy—a loyal and courageous knight—is called to action. As chaos spreads across the toy world, driven by the vengeful Baba Yaga plushie and her sinister army, it’s up to Teddy to rise, face the darkness, and fight through haunted toys to restore peace to the realm of playthings! Physics-Powered Combat Engage in fast-paced, physics-based battles that require strategy and reflexes, pushing enemies off platforms and knocking them back to the bottom of the toy chest. Each room offers unique opportunities for creative takedowns! Dash, Bounce, and Chain Combos Inspired by Smash Bros, Teddy Knight introduces bouncy physics to combat, letting you launch enemies in every direction and chain them into thrilling combo attacks. Customize your playstyle Collect powerful upgrades, items, and abilities that allow you to build a unique approach to combat. Experiment with different strategies to match your playstyle and take on increasingly challenging foes. Progress through the sinister depths of the toy chest, where forgotten toys create a world full of mystery. Each area offers unique challenges, hidden secrets, and an atmosphere that grows darker and more threatening as you progress. Rediscover each level in Nightmare Mode, where the difficulty ramps up and the atmosphere takes on an even darker, more ominous tone. Conquer this mode to unlock new abilities, challenges, and rewards. Are you ready to brave the toy chest and face the darkness within? Grab your hammer, take a deep breath, and prepare to dash and bounce in Teddy Knight!
row.short_description: Step into the paws of an unlikely hero and journey through the toy chest! In Teddy Knight, a physics-based action roguelite, you play as Teddy, a brave stuffed knight on a mission to save the toy world from evil. Engage in fast-paced combat with unique “bounce” mechanics in a dark toy universe.

row.name: AlibAi
row.detailed_description: AlibAi is a thrilling, AI-driven murder mystery game where you, the player, take on the role of a clever imposter hidden among a group of NPCs. As suspicions rise and alibis are tested, your goal is simple but intense: deceive, mislead, and outwit the AI characters to survive. As each day unfolds, you navigate tense conversations, select night-time targets, and attempt to frame others—all while concealing your role as the true killer. Blending a murder-mystery setup with the cunning mechanics of a social deduction game, AlibAi challenges you to manipulate the story and dodge accusations. Think you're clever enough to convince AI-driven NPCs that someone else is to blame? Key Features: Unique Murder Mystery Gameplay Make strategic choices in night-time actions and morning conversations to shift suspicion onto others and avoid getting caught. Immersive AI-Driven Conversations Interact with advanced AI NPCs, each with unique personalities, alibis, and motivations, who adapt and respond based on your actions. Dynamic Social Deduction Each round, try to deduce what the other characters are thinking, manipulate their trust, and use misdirection to guide the blame away from you. Strategic Room Selection and Night-time Actions Move between rooms with intent; each night offers a new opportunity to corner a target or shift suspicion elsewhere. Narrative Twists and Unexpected AI Reactions The AI characters may have unique suspicions or even provide information that’s partially true yet damaging to your plan, keeping gameplay unpredictable. Prepare for a challenging journey as you bluff, mislead, and survive in this single-player game of deception and deduction. AlibAi combines clean, pixel art-inspired environments with a sleek UI and sound design meant to pull players into an intense atmosphere of secrecy and suspicion. Make the wrong move, and the NPCs may start to doubt you. Plan your actions wisely, and you might just walk away with the ultimate alibi.
row.short_description: An AI-driven murder mystery where you play as the killer. Deceive NPCs, shift suspicion, and outsmart the AIs to survive. Strategize late-night kills and morning conversations in a tense game of trickery and deception.

row.detailed_description: Lost & Found Collection is an immersive, PSX-style horror game where each VHS tape you discover unveils a unique story within the same eerie universe. Set in different but interconnected locations and timelines, each tape offers a fresh narrative and new mysteries to explore, drawing you deeper into the dark secrets of the world. Features: Multiple Stories: Every VHS tape contains a self-contained story, all within the same universe. Expanding Content: New tapes with fresh stories will be added over time, expanding the narrative. Retro PSX-Style Visuals: Experience a nostalgic, pixelated horror aesthetic. Atmospheric Gameplay: Engage in tense, story-driven gameplay, rich in mystery and suspense. Explore, uncover the truth, and dive into a chilling journey where every tape brings you closer to the heart of the mystery.
row.short_description: Lost & Found Collection is a game where players explore diverse stories on VHS tapes, each unfolding around the same time.

row.name: Hollow Space
row.detailed_description: At the beginning of the year 2153 , the research station ' Yellow Station ', located on the edge of the solar system, suddenly stopped responding to all communications from nearby ships and stations. The station was completely dead —there were no signs of life. No signals, not even automatic ones, were being transmitted. The silence was absolute... Hollow Space is an immersive multiplayer game that transports players to a mysterious, abandoned space station where tension and adrenaline reach their peak. By stepping into the shoes of a special crew member or a mutant, you face dangerous challenges that will determine the fate of the station. As a crew member , your main objective is to eliminate mutants and regain control of the station. Utilize your skills, strategy, and available resources to solve the station's puzzles, find hidden items, and avoid the dangers lurking at every turn. The game requires cooperation with other crew members to effectively confront mutant foes, whose combat abilities can surprise even the most skilled players.                          As a mutant , you must leverage your strength, agility, and intelligence to face off against the crew. Your mission is to fight the crew members and sabotage their plans while uncovering the station's secrets and gaining the upper hand. As a mutant, you have access to unique abilities that allow you to catch opponents off guard and create chaos in their ranks.
row.short_description: In Hollow Space, you are transported to an abandoned space station drifting on the edge of the galaxy. A rescue crew responds to a mysterious SOS signal, only to find that something terrifying lurks in the shadows. Will you dare to face the danger, or will you become the monster yourself?
row.notes: Hollow Space contains intense violence, horror themes, and dark, mature storytelling elements. Players may encounter graphic depictions of combat, blood, and disturbing scenarios set in a sci-fi horror environment. The game does not include sexual content but may involve tense scenes that could be unsettling for some audiences.

row.name: Constantine Scores
row.detailed_description: Constantine Scores is a single-player heisting first-person shooter. Set in the Year 2375, you work as a freelance agent, handling contracts for the United Earth Federation. As a mercenary, you fight against three factions in short contracts or randomized campaigns. Sent alone you must complete the objectives given to you by the director. With a contractor to help guide you in your missions. Upgrade your arsenal to gain more abilities, weapons, and perks to keep the playing field equal. Player Customization Players can customize their agent using the credits they earn from missions. Weapons such as your primary, secondary, and melee.  Augmentations that give special perks. Armors that give different stat boots. Alternative attacks utilizing a shoulder cannon. Abilities that give passive boosts when activated. Drones that assist in combat. Operator Ranks  are a prestige system that gives rewards. Contracts Contracts are short, replayable single-day missions. Fourteen missions will be available on launch. Each contract has randomization, including layout and objective location changes. Each mission pits you against one of the three factions and can only be completed by going loud. Campaigns Campaigns are randomized multi-day contracts, utilizing solo contract missions and shuffling them to form a mini-campaign. This allows players to experience missions back-to-back in a random order that escalates from smaller missions to larger ones. On launch, you can expect to play three to five-day campaigns. Factions Constantines Empire.  Constantine was a rogue military general turned emperor. Uniting many disgruntled colonies to join the Empire, with an ambition to consolidate his power in the galaxy. Considered a main priority threat to the United Earth Federation. Orion Cartel.  An underground syndicate ruled by five families. They operate in the Constantine System. They are rapidly militarizing, and controlling the black market in the galaxy. Considered a secondary priority threat to the United Earth Federation.  Syn Corporation.  A security and research company. They provide valuable technology to Constantines Empire, in return for autonomy to work in their systems. Considered a tertiary priority threat to the United Earth Federation.
row.short_description: Constantine Scores is a single-player heisting Sci-fi First Person Shooter. Upgrade your arsenal to gain more abilities, weapons, and perks to keep the playing field equal. Fight against three separate factions, spanning multiple contracts, and randomized multi-day campaigns.

Missions involve general acts of robbery and the game includes settings to keep corpses around or have them vanish. Generic references to drugs, though nondescript. Inclusion of Low Poly NPCs that represent criminal or mature content, such as prostitutes, gangsters, strippers, and drug producers.

row.name: Speaker For The Machine
row.detailed_description: Thank you for visiting. Please read the help/settings inside the app and consider exploring.  This software is a prototype for a future game engine amongst other things so please support it in that endeavor. Thank you. About This Software This software assists the user in organization and retrieving information so that they may enhance their learning. Explore a powerful 3D node-based logic system that lets you create intricate, interactive networks where nodes send, process, and respond to messages. With a top-down design approach, you can connect nodes to build complex workflows, customizable interactions, and dynamic data structures. In addition, data is visible out in the world and is able to be given a 3D mesh to assist in remembering data by associating visually with it with what is known as the 'loci method'. In essence you store your data place it in the world and make connections to enhance your own learning capabilities.  Key Features Node Network Design Nodes : Each node holds a message and prompt, sending its message to connected nodes when triggered. Create complex designs by chaining nodes, allowing for branching paths, decision trees, and responsive interactions. Interactive Gates Destroy Gate : Removes messages that pass through it, controlling message flow. Redirect Gate : Routes messages to specified nodes, adding flexibility to your network. Clone Gate : Duplicates messages, enabling parallel message paths. Memory Gate : Stores messages and reproduces them under certain conditions. Merge Gate : Holds messages until a set count is reached, then releases them combined. Condition Gate : Directs messages based on specific string matches within the content. Music Gate : Plays user-added sounds by triggering associated notes within the network. Databank Gate : Adds messages to a databank, storing data as key-value pairs with descriptions and custom-painted images. Card Gate : Simulates a deck of cards, allowing you to shuffle and draw for randomized interactions. Random Gate : Returns random values, adding variety and unpredictability to the system. Music Creation Create music by adding notes that play when they pass through a Music Gate. Customize each note’s sound, enabling you to use this system as a musical composition tool. Visual Databank Store and manage data using the databank, which captures information as key-value pairs. Each entry can feature a description and a custom-painted image, making it ideal for data-rich projects and visually enhanced workflows. With limitless possibilities, this system is perfect for those who want to build interactive projects, compose music, manage data visually, and explore unique ways to connect and control nodes.
row.short_description: A versatile 3D node-based system for creating interactive networks and workflows. Connect nodes to send, process, and respond to messages, enabling complex designs, custom music compositions, and dynamic data storage. Control message flow with gates.

row.name: The Campsite
row.detailed_description: Somewhere in the Mediterranean... An enthusiastic adventurer is about to embark on a special mission: leading a chaotic team of unruly members in the hunt for a mysterious treasure. A vibrant night in the woods awaits, unveiling a memorable adventure, but beware—the shadows conceal a watchful presence. They are not alone... A Short But Intense Graphic Adventure The Campsite is a short point-and-click adventure game, inspired by and crafted in the style of early genre classics, and adapted for a modern-day experience. If you have a passion for graphic adventures but never find the time to play, this might be exactly what you’re looking for. With about 60 minutes of gameplay, a simplified UI, and no dialogue trees, it is an excellent choice for casual players. It can be played anytime, alone or with others, and is suitable for all ages. For those new to classic point-and-click adventures, The Campsite is a great starting point. Featuring a balanced difficulty level and lighter gameplay, it offers an accessible and enjoyable experience for beginners, and hopefully, you’ll be captivated by the magic that makes this genre so special! Features Rich storytelling: Explore richly crafted characters and an intricately woven storyline, featuring a three-act structure with captivating twists. Immersive soundtrack and SFX: A wide variety of original ambience sounds and music specially composed and recorded to match every mood and scene of the game. Meticulously crafted graphics: No AI-generated or processed images. Just labor-intensive hand-drawn pixel art. Enhanced accessibility: Enjoy a more inclusive gaming experience with hotspot highlighting, adjustable subtitle speed, dialogue clues, and more. Just point and click: Experience a monkey-friendly, simplified interface—every action is only a single click away! Car interior simulator included! Likely the first and only point-and-click adventure game to feature a realistic car interior simulator of the timeless Mediterranean classic, the '600,' fully equipped with cutting-edge technology. Credits The Campsite Created by G. Espias Localization: Spanish – Guillem Espias Catalan – David Castejon Traditional Chinese – Kinugawa © 2024-2025 Guillem Espias. All rights reserved.
row.short_description: The Campsite is a short, modern point-and-click adventure that retains the spirit of classic graphic adventures. row.name: Chimken
row.detailed_description: Chimkens is a creative and entertaining game that allows you to build your own levels using an intuitive editor and then share them with the community via Steam Workshop . With its simple building mechanics , players can easily create custom levels and share them with friends or other players online . The game features a local cooperative mode (COOP) where two players can play together on the same computer , solving challenges collaboratively. The player collision system enables fun interactions, such as climbing on each other to reach higher objects , adding a unique layer of teamwork. Additionally, the game incorporates competitive elements , ensuring both fun and challenging gameplay . Players can save, edit, and test their levels directly in the game through a user-friendly level management menu . They can also browse community-created levels , download maps , apply filters to find specific content , and play levels instantly. With Steam Workshop integration , players can effortlessly upload and share their creations , with an automated system that categorizes levels and generates preview images for each uploaded map. Whether you want to build, compete, or cooperate with friends , Chimkens offers simple yet engaging gameplay that continuously encourages players to create, explore, and enjoy user-generated content .

One day while alone working, her office was raided. Everything she has and has worked for was taken away in an instant. Imprisoned and accused of a crime she didn't commit, Aliya must find the truth before it’s too late. Interactive Cyberpunk World - Explore sprawling cityscapes, high-security prisons, and corporate offices, uncovering corruption hidden beneath the neon lights. Inspired by a True Story -  Dive into a story of friendship, loss, resilience, and the struggle for truth where the lines between truth and lies are blurred. Unique Gameplay Mechanics Zoom & Enhance - commandeer cutting-edge surveillance drones to perform unique in-game mechanics to zoom into buildings and utilize advanced AI to enhance and reconstruct crime scenes. Remote Hack  - Take up your own investigation. Uncover clues and mysteries as you become your own detective to prove your innocence. Full-Featured Computers Check emails, read messages, browse files, and uncover secrets. Investigate encrypted data, crack hidden codes, and make difficult decisions that will shape Aliya’s fate. Alternate-Reality Search for hidden websites, encrypted messages, and secret files that connect the game’s mystery to the real world. Solve ARG challenges to unlock additional in-game content, lore, and hidden paths in the story. A world that hides the truth is a world waiting to be hacked. Will you take control, or become just another victim of the system?
row.short_description: Aliya's Awakening: DOGE 2042 is a narrative-driven interactive cyberpunk adventure game with secrets, survival, and justice. Experience a deep, and personal story of Aliya, and with her point of view, explore the dystopian cyberpunk world through fun and immersive gameplay.

row.name: Spook Game
row.detailed_description: Dive into the dark and challenging world of Spook Game , a 2D endless game where your mission is to survive as long as possible against relentless waves of terrifying enemies. With each level, you'll face increasingly powerful and unpredictable creatures, demanding skill and strategy to advance and achieve high scores. Taking control of a character determined to eradicate supernatural threats, you'll battle ghosts, zombies, and other dark creatures, each with unique abilities and movement patterns. The PixelArt visuals create an immersive atmosphere where fast combat and quick reflexes are essential for survival. As you defeat enemies and face new challenges, the game allows you to hone your skills, boosting your performance and motivating you to go further. With a global leaderboard system and planned updates to add new enemies and mechanics, Spook Game offers an intense and thrilling experience that will challenge your persistence and sharpen your skills with each attempt. row.name: Imaginary Chaos Fight
row.detailed_description: Imaginary Chaos Fight is a 2D PvP fighting game where each character has unique abilities and mechanics that add a new layer of strategy to each match. Each of the six fighters presents distinct advantages and disadvantages: while some have powerful but slow attacks, others rely on speed and agile moves to dodge and counterattack. The abilities of each character are carefully designed to either complement or counter each other in combat, offering a dynamic experience full of strategic possibilities. Additionally, the game features unique and interactive maps, such as Jungle and Vulcan, which add exclusive mechanics to the battlefield. In the Jungle map, players are immersed in a dense forest with strategically positioned teleportation portals, allowing for quick movement between distant points on the map and surprising opponents. In the Vulcan map, players face a terrain filled with active geysers that provide powerful boosts for those who know how to use them strategically. These geysers allow players to quickly reach elevated areas, escape attacks, or surprise opponents with unexpected moves. Imaginary Chaos Fight combines these character and environment mechanics to create an intense and unpredictable combat experience, where character choice and map adaptation are crucial to achieving victory.
row.short_description: Imaginary Chaos Fight brings intense 2D PvP battles with six unique characters, each with special abilities allowing for diverse combat strategies. Explore different styles, master your tactics, and face off against opponents to prove who is the true champion.

row.name: Second Works
row.detailed_description: 『Second Works』 is a 2D platform action-adventure game set in a sci-fi fantasy world based on biotechnology. Players explore a vast world filled with diverse environments such as giant laboratories, toxic forests, and ancient cities, uncovering the secrets of a chaotic world. Enjoy the unique atmosphere created by colorful anime-style graphics and the thrilling experience of high-difficulty action. Story The new research project 'Second Works', which was supposed to bring hope, has created the energies of 'Order' and 'Chaos' that now envelop the world, and a new life form called the 'Fusion' through the fusion experiments. Humanity, having acquired great power, seemed to be on the brink of realizing a peaceful and higher-order world balanced between Order and Chaos. However, the energy of Chaos went out of control, and the world descended into madness due to mutated humans, remaining unchanged for many years. Now, with the awakening of a newly created Fusion girl named 'Zero', something is about to change......... Game Features Players explore a vast map, engage in conversations with various characters, and collect items while challenging numerous stages scattered across the world. Throughout their journey, they will face impenetrable barriers and powerful bosses. As they explore, they will unlock 'Souls' that grant additional effects, 'Elixirs' usable within stages, and unique playable characters, broadening their strategic options. Experience the satisfaction of overcoming trials and breaking through with your own hands.

In agriculture, players can cultivate rice, wheat, flax, mulberry leaves, tree paint, and other crops to obtain food and raw materials. Industry, players can build industrial buildings, which can produce daily necessities such as porcelain, lacquerware, copperware, textiles, paper, jade, etc. Military, players can train soldiers of various branches of the army, plunder player resources, and attack other cities on the world map through gameplay.

Move using the keyboard, aim and fire with the mouse, kill everything that crawls of flies, get through mazes full of deadly traps, survive battles with robotic bosses and save the Earth.

row.name: Letters from the War
row.detailed_description: OVERVIEW Letters from the War is a modern reimagining of text adventure games with a new gameplay based on postal censorship during Second World War. You will take the role of a newly hired employ of the Censorship Authority, where your actions will impact on the future of your nation. GAMEPLAY Censor letters coming from soldiers at the front trying to understand what you need to do not to be fired. Censoring critical information you will get commendations from your boss, but the citizens who youl receive the letters will not understand their content. Leaving the information readable you will risk to be fired in order to let the people know what is really happening. What will you do? Will you find the correct balance? STORY The game takes place in Vitulia, a fictional country involved in Second World War. An authoritarian regime rules in Vitualia, which controls the masses thanks to its supervision on public information. Will you change that? ART Experience a well-finished pixel art and an original soundtrack that will immerse you in the atmosphere of those years. Newspaper, letters and country spots were created, along with the music pieces, taking inspiration from first half of last century sources, but redesigned to enhance player experience.

row.name: Hock
row.detailed_description: Choose from over 20 classes to push, pull, grab, shoot, shove, slice, and explode your way to victory. Use the classes' unique abilities and nuances to control the puck and dominate your opponent. The Gunner Although the Gunner has below average speed and power, it uses its bullet to supplement its mobility and force. With the lowest ability cool-down in the game it is able to use its bullet for a wide range of applications, like using the recoil for speed, shooting the other car to disrupt its movement, or just shooting the puck for a shot on goal. The Pillbug The Pillbug is the mascot of Hock. It makes up for its lack of an ability with its excellent power and shape. The Pillbug is able to power through just about every class and can use its rounded shape to hit extremely precise shots with the right player behind the controls. The Blimp The Blimp is an extremely light and floaty class that can drop a massive wall into the arena. Since the blimp struggles to push or block classes on its own, it deploys its wall to help out. The usage of the wall greatly depends on the type of Blimp player. Many Blimp players opt for a more defensive strategy, using the wall to block any openings, while many others use it offensively, hurling it at their opponent and the puck like a projectile. Overall, the gameplay and strategy of Hock greatly is decided by the player! With the wide range of classes and play styles, there is something for every type of person in Hock. What will you play?

row.name: Scauage
row.detailed_description: You take on the role of a scavenger, searching for valuables in the ruins of an abandoned town. Entering a house to loot, you quickly realize you've stepped into a nightmare about to unfold. FEATURES A unique short horror journey driven by an unnerving sense of paranoia and claustrophobia. Multiple endings based on the decisions made throughout the game. Realistic movement/flashlight mechanics that offer complete immersion. Unconventional puzzles that require thinking outside the box. Atmospheric 3D sounds, enhancing the experience and instilling dread.  PS1/PSX retro era pixelated aesthetics, supporting the feeling of 1960s America. STORY The town of Prefield was once a bustling hub, built to support the nearby mines and the promise of rich mineral resources. Over time, though, the mines ran dry, and the town began to fade. Families left in search of better opportunities, leading to a slow socioeconomic decline. What was once a lively community turned into a ghost town, notorious for marauders and scavengers who now roamed the area in search of a fortune. Prefield became a place where few dared to stay, except for those who had nowhere else to go — squatters and the homeless found shelter in the abandoned houses. You take on the role of a scavenger, looking for valuable items hidden away in the remnants of Prefield. One building stands out to you: an old two-story country house that seems to hold something worthwhile. You decide to explore and see whether there is anything of value that you can take for yourself.
row.short_description: Scauage is a short horror experience where you play as a scavenger looting an abandoned house, uncovering its dark secrets and collecting hidden treasures while facing what lurks within.

row.name: RenewEd3D
row.detailed_description: RenewEd3D is an interactive software designed to enhance Renewable Energy Education (REE) through Non-Immersive Virtual Reality. It integrates images, text explanations, voice narration, animations, and quizzes to facilitate learning. The software is bilingual, offering narration in both English and Malay to assist students, especially in pronunciation of scientific terms. Students explore the content, engaging with different modules and answering quizzes at the end of each session. Its goal is to raise awareness of renewable energy in an engaging and immersive way. The gameplay in RenewEd3D  revolves around an exploration of renewable energy concepts through a series of themed levels. Here's a breakdown of how the gameplay is structured: 1. Level Exploration: Students navigate through different levels, each designed to present a new aspect of renewable energy education. The levels are structured to encourage active learning and exploration: Level 1: The Beginning Level 2: Energy Crisis Level 3: Inspiration Level 4: Exploration Level 5: New Hope 2. Interaction and Learning: Virtual Interactions : Students explore various renewable energy systems (such as wind, solar, hydro, etc.) in virtual environments. These environments are designed to mimic real-world scenarios, allowing players to interact with energy systems, solve energy-related challenges, and make decisions that affect the outcome of their virtual energy projects. Quizzes and Challenges : At the end of each level, students face a quiz or challenge that tests their understanding of the concepts covered. The quizzes are integrated into the gameplay, ensuring that students apply what they’ve learned and reinforce key concepts through interactive feedback. Rewards and Progression : As players complete quizzes and challenges, they earn points or rewards, unlocking new levels and gaining access to more complex content. 3. Mode Selection (Individual vs. Group Mode): Individual Mode : In this mode, each player works independently to explore the content, complete challenges, and track their own progress. Scores and certificates are generated based on individual performance. Group Mode : In Group Mode, players can collaborate with others, working as a team to solve challenges, explore energy systems, and discuss concepts together. The group mode tracks the collective performance of the group, fostering teamwork and cooperation. 4. Feedback and Certificates: Instant Feedback : Players receive instant feedback on their quiz answers and performance during challenges, helping them to understand where they may need improvement. Certificates : After completing the levels and achieving certain milestones, students are awarded certificates to recognize their learning achievements. Overall, RenewEd3D  combines interactive, educational gameplay with immersive virtual environments to engage students in renewable energy education, encouraging both individual and collaborative learning experiences.
row.short_description: 3D Digital Game-Based Learning.

row.name: Dreamship Sugarcube
row.detailed_description: It turned out to be just a dream. This is a gamejam work developed by a team of four people within ten days. It is a third-person 3D space adventure game. The theme of the game development is 'dreams', so the game's background is set in a space adventure within a dream. Its core gameplay involves simulating jumping and flying under the gravitational force of planets. However, please note that all of this is just a child's dream, so the gravitational simulation is not rigorous. It is simply achieved by interpolating the direction of gravity towards the center of the planet closest to the player and updating the gravitational scalar. As a result, there may be situations where a small planet has a stronger attracting ability than a larger planet with a greater radius. The game includes seven playable levels. Although the difficulty has been adjusted and there are players who can operate smoothly on their first playthrough, for players who are proficient in operating the game, the difficulty may already be quite low. However, some players still find it difficult to get started and may get stuck in the first three levels. This is a problem caused by the author's lack of experience in game design, and we apologize for that. Please pay attention to the tutorial text in the first level and the golden landmark hints within the levels.
row.short_description: Still confused and checking the fuel gauge mid-flight? Struggling to find the target when flying under a planet? Sorry, its all on the author! Due to low player numbers and the my internships, theres been no game update. If you enjoy it and have ideas for improvement, leave a comment or email us.

row.name: Maximum Chaser : 1001 Squad
row.detailed_description: This game is based on a Flash game: Hostility Ultimate Force(UF)2 : 2112 Cooperation - Original Producer of the series: 3DBBQ ———————————————————————————————————————— The story takes place in a universe similar to ours, where the human beings on Earth have made great technological leaps and are about to reach 'stellar civilization', and interstellar travel with neighboring planets is no longer a difficult task. But the Earth is in a serious energy catastrophe, with uneven energy distribution and growing disparity between the rich and the poor. In the past, there was a powerful heroic organization that maintained peace on Earth, but after a fierce battle with a huge evil biological research institute, both disappeared. But new evil forces are emerging in an endless stream, and small street organizations are beginning to emerge around the world at this time, contributing their own meager strength to continue the hero's duty. 'Maximum Chaser' is one of them. You will play two members of the 'Maximum Chaser': Kai (Member Num: 10) and Lily (Member Num: 01), and fight against an evil security company A.A.S.S. . The game is designed for single-player play, which means you need to control the characters on both screens at the same time. As the game progresses, the shooting method will also change. At this time, you will need to judge which side of the screen you should focus more on. Don't worry, it won't be difficult. Of course, you can also take on two-player challenges with your friends. This game does not support remote network connection, so you can only work together locally with your friends sitting in front of the same computer.
row.short_description: It is a universe similar to ours, where humans are technologically advanced but also full of evil. You will play as 2 member of the street organization 'Maximum Chaser' and confront an evil security company A.A.S.S., making them scream under your gunfire.

row.name: Whisperstring
row.detailed_description: Whisperstring is an 80s inspired text adventure game that takes place inside a “chat room”. You’re connected to Adam, a 'jock' with a severe fear of strings, who seems to have been the victim of a supernatural kidnapping. Will you be able to help him escape? Whisperstring was a chat program developed by &&&$$$SSS66 (pronounced “And-Es-Six”) and released in the late 1980s. While it never gained the popularity of its IRC-based counterparts, it did have a small community of enthusiasts. Instead of focusing on chat rooms, it connected two random strangers who could chat one-on-one. While the mentioned enthusiasts are by now mostly non-existent, our team has decided to preserve the software and make it compatible with modern computers. Feel free to give it a try, and maybe you’ll soon join us as part of the (hopefully) growing team of Whisperstring enthusiasts! To quote the wise words of &&&$$$SSS66: “Don't forget that you'll be talking to a real person. Don't be a dick. [...] Have fun!” You can listen to and download the soundtrack for free on bandcamp. Features: Command line processing : Interact with the game world by typing text commands. Puzzles : Explore Adam's 'prison', use items, and decipher clues to progress through the story. Player agency : Different text prompts allow you to infuse the main character with your own personality.
row.short_description: Whisperstring is an 80s inspired text adventure game that takes place inside a “chat room”. You’re connected to Adam, a 'jock' with a severe fear of strings, who seems to have been the victim of a supernatural kidnapping. Will you be able to help him escape?

row.name: Rogue Samurai: Prologue

Master your skills, unlock powerful abilities, and face epic boss battles in a quest for survival. Face relentless waves of enemies in intense, fast-paced combat. Each encounter tests your reflexes and strategy as you cut through foes with precision and skill. Survival is your only option in this unforgiving world. Master a variety of samurai techniques and unlock powerful abilities. Customize your playstyle by strategically using your skills to dominate enemies, adapt to challenges, and emerge victorious in epic battles. Each location is a new battlefield, filled with enemies, power-ups, and opportunities to hone your samurai skills. Adapt or perish! Expand your arsenal as you progress, unlocking a variety of weapons each with unique attributes and combat styles. row.short_description: Experience intense roguelite action in Rogue Samurai: Prologue. Play as a legendary samurai fighting relentless waves of enemies in this free version. Master your skills, unlock abilities, and face epic boss battles in your quest for survival.

row.name: Bone To Gather

Show that even seemingly insignificant, puny skeletons can rise to become the strongest and prove everyone wrong! Variety of Unique Skeletons The skeletons come from various backgrounds and have different roles. Meet a popstar from the slums, a clown from a pirate crew, and a cleaner from a magic academy who have gathered from all over the land to reclaim the pride of skeletons. row.name: InKing

row.name: Balantica
row.detailed_description: Balancing Hope Managing the Hope of Two Souls Assigning cards to the twins adds hope to each side of the scale. If the difference in their hope grows too large, the scale will tip, and its balance will begin to falter. When the scale tips completely and balance cannot be restored, its health decreases. Additionally, failing to accumulate enough hope to surpass the set despair value for each trial also reduces the scale’s health. If the scale’s health is fully depleted, the journey can no longer continue. Evolving Relationships After each trial, the tilt of the scale affects the twins’ relationship. With strong Rapport, building hope becomes easier. In states of Conflict, it becomes much harder. Strategically Build and Use Your Cards A Variety of Card Effects Cards assigned to the twins do more than give hope-they offer a variety of effects. Plan your deck carefully, considering the synergies between card effects. Exclusive Cards Some cards can only be assigned to one twin. Strategize your deck composition while keeping the number of exclusive cards in mind. Choices on the Journey Crossroads of Dilemmas The path to the alter, the final destination, splits into many routes. At these crossroads, the twins will encounter various individuals and face unexpected situations.

If you fail to restore the required memory within the time limit, the surgery will end in failure. Build your own gear deck and create powerful synergy. utilize gears with unique synergies. Try to create your own synergy strategy by adding, upgrading, or sometimes removing gears to your deck as a reward for each stage clear.

row.name: The Permanent Residence : Souls Kept
row.detailed_description: The Permanent Residence pulls you into the unsettling world of an isolated bungalow shrouded in mystery and dread. You step into the shoes of a traveling musician, stranded after your shows are suddenly canceled. Desperate and tempted by a 50% discount, you take up an offer to stay in this strange house, blissfully unaware of the horrors that await. The once-quiet halls now hum with whispers, and the walls seem to hide secrets aching to be uncovered. As you piece together strange clues, the bungalow’s chilling history unfolds—a past filled with rituals, vanishings, and a dark presence that refuses to let go. Soon, you realize that walking out the door might not be as simple as walking in. The Permanent Residence : Souls Kept In Souls Kept , the first chapter of ' The Permanent Residence' series, you take on the role of a musician drawn into the chilling mystery of an isolated bungalow. With only cryptic diary entries and unsettling photographs left behind by a vanished wedding photographer to guide you, you’ll piece together the terrifying events that have cursed this house. Can you uncover its secrets before it’s too late? Will you find a way out, or will you become yet another soul ensnared in its dark, unrelenting grip? More episodes are planned for the future—each one delving deeper into the cursed legacy of The   Permanent Residence . Key Features Atmospheric Exploration: Roam through an intricately detailed house filled with clues and eerie ambiance. Narrative-Driven Clues: Discover diary entries from previous residents, like a vanished wedding photographer, to piece together the house’s dark history. Paranormal Encounters: Experience haunting events that escalate as you uncover the bungalow’s secrets. Immersive Sound Design: Feel the terror through subtle whispers, unsettling noises, and a soundscape that heightens dread. Psychological Horror: Navigate a looping nightmare of fear, guilt, and despair that blurs the lines between reality and the infernal. Descent into Hell: Witness a twisted depiction of hell as the house reveals its true, horrifying nature.

row.name: 海子 UMIKO
row.detailed_description: '海子 UMIKO' is a psychological horror visual novel. Through direct conversations between the player and the unfamiliar girl 'Umiko,' as well as fragmented narratives hidden within mini-games and puzzles, this game pieces together a past event that occurred in her dimension. Game Content Engage in conversations with the unfamiliar girl 'Umiko,' complete various mini-games, solve puzzles, read hidden texts, collect all the photos in the album, piece together the complete story of Umiko and her dimension's past and present, attempt to change how the story ends, and do everything you can to maintain your fragile friendship for a week! Game Duration : Approximately 1 hour;  Number of Endings : 6 wrong endings and 1 true ending. About Story This is a story about 【Ending】 . As summer approaches and summer nears its end, the lively and adorable unfamiliar girl 'Umiko' sends you a cross-dimensional call request. Chatting with her might be a great way to pass the time! Whether the topic is friendship, food, or fashion, she is always willing to talk openly with you. Gradually uncover Umiko's story and the world she inhabits through lighthearted and harmonious interactions! ...However, what exactly is the 【unforgivable, irreversible thing】 that Umiko has been trying to hide, the thing she once did? When and where did the story about 【Me】 , 【Leader】 , and 【Senior】 that appears on the screen take place? The occasional static, screen distortions, and faint low-frequency noises... Everything feels unsettling yet intriguing. Still, no matter what happens on the other side of the screen, it won't affect 【you】 , so there's nothing to worry about. Content Warning During gameplay, there may be loud noises, screen flickering, and sudden horror elements. This game is not suitable for individuals with photosensitive epilepsy,  children or those who are easily disturbed.

row.name: Alien Grounds
row.detailed_description: Brutal. Fast. Free. Alien Grounds is a score-driven arcade FPS where pressure escalates quickly and mastery is the only thing that carries you forward. This is not a campaign shooter. There’s no safety net to lean on. You spawn. You fight. You adapt. Then you try to do it better. Arcade FPS at Its Core Alien Grounds is designed around repeatable runs , not progression trees. Sessions are fast and focused Pressure escalates quickly Every mistake costs momentum Every good decision pushes your score higher You will die. You will restart. You will improve. That loop is the game. Combat That Tests Judgment, Not Just Aim Enemies are readable, distinct, and unforgiving: Fast rushers that punish poor positioning Heavy melee threats that demand spacing and timing Ranged enemies that pressure movement Rare variants that bend the rules and invite risk Combat stays clear even in dark environments, with strong silhouettes and visual cues designed for split-second decisions. Maps shift mid-fight, forcing constant movement and adaptation. No two runs play the same. Weapons With Tradeoffs, Not Comfort Each weapon exists for a reason - and a tradeoff: Pistol - Low damage, limited ammo. Highest score potential through precision headshots. Automatic Rifle - Reliable DPS with recoil and spread. Ammo resupplies when low. Laser Gun - Infinite energy and perfect accuracy, but overheats if overused. Gravity Gun - Infinite energy and no recoil, but speeds up the fight. Annihilator - Close-range panic button with a short recharge. Chem Gun - Crowd setup weapon that wipes groups once thresholds are reached. Freeze Gun - Area control tool that locks enemies in place. Powerful tools exist - but precision and risk always score higher. Score Is the Goal Alien Grounds rewards how you play: Precision kills score more Faster play increases risk and reward High-threat enemies are worth more Special bonuses reward control under pressure Brute force works. Mastery scores higher. Global leaderboards track your best runs. Ranks are permanent. Difficulty That Respects the Player Easy - Relaxed and forgiving. Learn the systems. Medium - The intended experience. Balance and precision matter. Hard - No tutorials. Aggressive enemies. Tight resources. Highest multipliers. Hard mode isn’t unfair. It’s uncompromising. Just Play No microtransactions. No paywalls. No grind. Alien Grounds is a solo-developed arcade FPS built around clarity, speed, and mastery . Hit Play. Chase a better run. Accessibility & Controls Scales well on lower-end PCs with adjustable graphics settings Full gamepad support (raw input, aim assist, full sensitivity control) Mouse and controller Y-axis invert Left-handed keyboard and mouse layouts Steam Deck tested

row.name: Kings of Emperor Bonaparte
row.detailed_description: A big thank you to Epic History TV for providing the audio for our video trailer. Epic History TV is a world-renowned leader in historical storytelling. Be sure to check them out on YouTube for more amazing content. About Kings of Emperor Bonaparte: Kings of Emperor Bonaparte extends the classic vanilla wargame skirmish by providing a dynamic, persistent 24/7 war that anyone can join at any time. This online PvP experience recreates the intensity of the Napoleonic Wars, offering players the chance to take part in a massive, ongoing conflict that evolves with every skirmish and battle. Set in the historical region of Alessandria in Northern Italy, players will fight for control of key locations, pushing the frontlines and changing the tides of war with every victory and defeat. Future plans include expanding the map to cover the full breadth of the Napoleonic campaigns, from Paris to Moscow. Players can choose to side with either the French Empire or the Coalition forces, engaging in fierce battles to capture towns and strategic positions. Each faction brings its own unique playstyle and tactical options, from powerful infantry formations to decisive cavalry charges. You'll need to adapt to changing battlefield conditions, plan your assaults, and coordinate with your allies to achieve victory. The game offers an immersive historical experience, with authentic units, weapons, and tactics inspired by the Napoleonic Wars. Whether leading a cavalry charge or commanding artillery to bombard enemies, you'll be immersed in the chaos and strategy of 19th-century warfare. The persistent nature of the game ensures that every skirmish affects the greater war effort, making each player's contribution meaningful in the grand campaign. Do you have what it takes to change history? Join the fight in Kings of Emperor Bonaparte and lead your faction to victory!
